name: PaperC.ResidualMasses.disjoint_sigmaZero_positiveSigmaSmallProductPairs
statement:
theorem disjoint_sigmaZero_positiveSigmaSmallProductPairs
    {N A L : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    Disjoint
      (sigmaZeroSmallProductPairs N A L hN)
      (positiveSigmaSmallProductPairs N A L hN)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro pair hzero hpositive
  rw [mem_sigmaZeroSmallProductPairs] at hzero
  rw [mem_positiveSigmaSmallProductPairs] at hpositive
  omega

name: PaperC.ResidualMasses.sigmaZero_union_positiveSigma_eq_activeSmallProductPairs
statement:
theorem sigmaZero_union_positiveSigma_eq_activeSmallProductPairs
    {N A L : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    sigmaZeroSmallProductPairs N A L hN ∪
        positiveSigmaSmallProductPairs N A L hN =
      activeSmallProductPairs N A L hN
proof:
:= by
  ext pair
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, mem_sigmaZeroSmallProductPairs,
    mem_positiveSigmaSmallProductPairs]
  constructor
  · rintro (hzero | hpositive)
    · exact hzero.1
    · exact hpositive.1
  · intro hactive
    by_cases hzero : pairSigma A pair = 0
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hactive, hzero⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hactive, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero⟩

name: PaperC.ResidualMasses.card_activeSmallProductPairValues
statement:
theorem card_activeSmallProductPairValues
    (N A L : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    (activeSmallProductPairValues N A L hN).card =
      (activeSmallProductPairs N A L hN).card
proof:
:= by
  unfold activeSmallProductPairValues
  exact Finset.card_image_of_injective
    (activeSmallProductPairs N A L hN) Subtype.val_injective

name: PaperC.ResidualMasses.activeSmallProductPairValues_subset_relationalHosts
statement:
theorem activeSmallProductPairValues_subset_relationalHosts
    {N A L : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    activeSmallProductPairValues N A L hN ⊆
      RelationalHosts.relationalHosts N L
proof:
:= by
  intro pair hpair
  rw [activeSmallProductPairValues, Finset.mem_image] at hpair
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hpair
  have hzActive := mem_activeSmallProductPairs.mp hz
  have hzSep := mem_separatedDyadicPairs.mp z.2
  rw [RelationalHosts.mem_relationalHosts]
  refine ⟨hzSep.1, hzSep.2.1, hzSep.2.2, ?_⟩
  have hrho :=
    pairRho_eq_pairSigma_add_pairTau
      (A := A) hN z
  unfold pairRho at hrho
  calc
    0 < pairSigma A z + pairTau A hN z := by omega
    _ = relationRho
        (twoStartSystem (dyadicCutoff N L) z.1.1 z.1.2 L) :=
      hrho.symm

name: PaperC.ResidualMasses.card_activeSmallProductPairs_le_relationalHosts
statement:
theorem card_activeSmallProductPairs_le_relationalHosts
    {N A L : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    (activeSmallProductPairs N A L hN).card ≤
      (RelationalHosts.relationalHosts N L).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_activeSmallProductPairValues N A L hN]
  exact Finset.card_le_card
    (activeSmallProductPairValues_subset_relationalHosts hN)

name: PaperC.ResidualMasses.activeSmallProductQuadraticResidualMass_eq_sigmaZero_add_positiveSigma
statement:
theorem activeSmallProductQuadraticResidualMass_eq_sigmaZero_add_positiveSigma
    {N A L : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    activeSmallProductQuadraticResidualMass N A L hN =
      sigmaZeroQuadraticResidualMass N A L hN +
        positiveSigmaQuadraticResidualMass N A L hN
proof:
:= by
  rw [activeSmallProductQuadraticResidualMass]
  rw [← sigmaZero_union_positiveSigma_eq_activeSmallProductPairs
    (A := A) hN]
  unfold sigmaZeroQuadraticResidualMass
  unfold positiveSigmaQuadraticResidualMass
  unfold quadraticResidualMass
  exact Finset.sum_union
    (disjoint_sigmaZero_positiveSigmaSmallProductPairs
      (A := A) hN)

name: PaperC.ResidualMasses.activeSmallProductLinearResidualMass_eq_sigmaZero_add_positiveSigma
statement:
theorem activeSmallProductLinearResidualMass_eq_sigmaZero_add_positiveSigma
    {N A L : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    activeSmallProductLinearResidualMass N A L hN =
      sigmaZeroLinearResidualMass N A L hN +
        positiveSigmaLinearResidualMass N A L hN
proof:
:= by
  rw [activeSmallProductLinearResidualMass]
  rw [← sigmaZero_union_positiveSigma_eq_activeSmallProductPairs
    (A := A) hN]
  unfold sigmaZeroLinearResidualMass
  unfold positiveSigmaLinearResidualMass
  unfold linearResidualMass
  exact Finset.sum_union
    (disjoint_sigmaZero_positiveSigmaSmallProductPairs
      (A := A) hN)

name: PaperC.ResidualMasses.smallProductQuadraticResidualMass_eq_active
statement:
theorem smallProductQuadraticResidualMass_eq_active
    {N A L : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    smallProductQuadraticResidualMass N A L hN =
      activeSmallProductQuadraticResidualMass N A L hN
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold smallProductQuadraticResidualMass
  unfold activeSmallProductQuadraticResidualMass
  unfold quadraticResidualMass
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset
    (activeSmallProductPairs_subset_smallProductPairs
      (A := A) hN)
  intro pair hpairSmall hpairNotActive
  have htau : pairTau A hN pair = 0 := by
    have hnotPos : ¬ 0 < pairTau A hN pair := by
      intro hpos
      exact hpairNotActive
        (mem_activeSmallProductPairs.mpr
          ⟨mem_smallProductPairs.mp hpairSmall, hpos⟩)
    omega
  exact quadraticResidualWeight_eq_zero_of_pairTau_eq_zero htau

name: PaperC.ResidualMasses.smallProductLinearResidualMass_eq_active
statement:
theorem smallProductLinearResidualMass_eq_active
    {N A L : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :

      activeSmallProductLinearResidualMass N A L hN
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold smallProductLinearResidualMass
  unfold activeSmallProductLinearResidualMass
  unfold linearResidualMass
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset
    (activeSmallProductPairs_subset_smallProductPairs
      (A := A) hN)
  intro pair hpairSmall hpairNotActive
  have htau : pairTau A hN pair = 0 := by
    have hnotPos : ¬ 0 < pairTau A hN pair := by
      intro hpos
      exact hpairNotActive
        (mem_activeSmallProductPairs.mpr
          ⟨mem_smallProductPairs.mp hpairSmall, hpos⟩)
    omega
  exact linearResidualWeight_eq_zero_of_pairTau_eq_zero htau

name: PaperC.ResidualMasses.smallProductQuadraticResidualMass_eq_sigmaZero_add_positiveSigma
statement:
theorem smallProductQuadraticResidualMass_eq_sigmaZero_add_positiveSigma
    {N A L : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    smallProductQuadraticResidualMass N A L hN =
      sigmaZeroQuadraticResidualMass N A L hN +
        positiveSigmaQuadraticResidualMass N A L hN
proof:
:= by
  rw [smallProductQuadraticResidualMass_eq_active hN]
  exact
    activeSmallProductQuadraticResidualMass_eq_sigmaZero_add_positiveSigma
      (A := A) hN

name: PaperC.ResidualMasses.smallProductLinearResidualMass_eq_sigmaZero_add_positiveSigma
statement:
theorem smallProductLinearResidualMass_eq_sigmaZero_add_positiveSigma
    {N A L : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    smallProductLinearResidualMass N A L hN =
      sigmaZeroLinearResidualMass N A L hN +
        positiveSigmaLinearResidualMass N A L hN

name: PaperC.ResidualMasses.smallProductLinearResidualMass_cast_le
statement:
theorem smallProductLinearResidualMass_cast_le
    {N A L : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    (smallProductLinearResidualMass N A L hN : ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt ((RelationalHosts.relationalHosts N L).card : ℝ) *
        Real.sqrt (smallProductQuadraticResidualMass N A L hN : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hinterp :=
    linearResidualMass_cast_le_sqrt_card_mul_sqrt_quadratic
      (A := A) hN (activeSmallProductPairs N A L hN)
  have hcard :
      ((activeSmallProductPairs N A L hN).card : ℝ) ≤
        ((RelationalHosts.relationalHosts N L).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast card_activeSmallProductPairs_le_relationalHosts
      (A := A) hN
  rw [smallProductLinearResidualMass_eq_active hN]
  rw [smallProductQuadraticResidualMass_eq_active hN]
  unfold activeSmallProductLinearResidualMass
  unfold activeSmallProductQuadraticResidualMass
  exact hinterp.trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hcard)
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))

name: PaperC.SectionElevenPartition.sectorOf_eq_smallPrimeProduct_iff

      tests.smallPrimeProduct z

:= by

    by_cases h₂ : tests.smallCanonicalHeight z <;>
      by_cases h₃ : tests.shallowCore z <;>
        by_cases h₄ : tests.aligned z <;>
          by_cases h₅ : tests.manyDefects z <;>

statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_sectorPopulation
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    {tests : OrderedSectorTests Ω}
    {sector : ResidualSector} {z : Ω} :
    z ∈ sectorPopulation tests sector ↔
      sectorOf tests z = sector
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [sectorPopulation]

name: PaperC.SectionElevenPartition.sectorPopulations_disjoint
statement:
theorem sectorPopulations_disjoint
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (tests : OrderedSectorTests Ω)
    {s t : ResidualSector} (hst : s ≠ t) :
    Disjoint
      (sectorPopulation tests s)
      (sectorPopulation tests t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro z hzs hzt
  have hs : sectorOf tests z = s :=
    mem_sectorPopulation.mp hzs
  have ht : sectorOf tests z = t :=
    mem_sectorPopulation.mp hzt
  exact hst (hs.symm.trans ht)

name: PaperC.SectionElevenPartition.seven_sector_populations_cover
statement:
theorem seven_sector_populations_cover
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (tests : OrderedSectorTests Ω) :
    ((((((sectorPopulation tests .smallPrimeProduct ∪
              sectorPopulation tests .smallCanonicalHeight) ∪
            sectorPopulation tests .shallowCore) ∪
          sectorPopulation tests .alignedDeepCore) ∪
        sectorPopulation tests .manyDefects) ∪
      sectorPopulation tests .nonterminal) ∪
      sectorPopulation tests .terminal) =
        Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext z
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, mem_sectorPopulation,
    Finset.mem_univ, iff_true]
  cases hsector : sectorOf tests z <;> simp [hsector]

name: PaperC.SectionElevenPartition.existsUnique_sector
statement:
theorem existsUnique_sector
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (tests : OrderedSectorTests Ω) (z : Ω) :
    ∃! sector : ResidualSector,
      z ∈ sectorPopulation tests sector
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨sectorOf tests z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact mem_sectorPopulation.mpr rfl
  · intro sector hsector
    exact (mem_sectorPopulation.mp hsector).symm

name: PaperC.SectionElevenPartition.not_smallCanonicalPrimeProduct_iff_large
statement:
@[simp]
theorem not_smallCanonicalPrimeProduct_iff_large

name: PaperC.SectionElevenPartition.sectionEleven_lateSectors_eq_deepCorePairs
statement:
theorem sectionEleven_lateSectors_eq_deepCorePairs
    {N A L : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (isTerminal : SeparatedDyadicPair N L → Prop) :
    (((sectionElevenSectorPairs A hN isTerminal
              .alignedDeepCore ∪
            sectionElevenSectorPairs A hN isTerminal
              .manyDefects) ∪
          sectionElevenSectorPairs A hN isTerminal
            .nonterminal) ∪
        sectionElevenSectorPairs A hN isTerminal
          .terminal) =
      SectionSevenPartition.deepCorePairs N A L hN
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext pair
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, mem_sectionElevenSectorPairs,
    SectionSevenPartition.mem_deepCorePairs]
  constructor
  · rintro (((hfour | hfive) | hsix) | hseven)
    · have h :=
        sectionElevenSectorOf_eq_four_iff.mp hfour
      refine ⟨?_, h.2.1, ?_⟩
      · simpa [HasLargeCanonicalPrimeProduct] using h.1
      · unfold HasCoreDensityAtMostThreeSixteenths at h
        omega
    · have h :=
        sectionElevenSectorOf_eq_five_iff.mp hfive
      refine ⟨?_, h.2.1, ?_⟩
      · simpa [HasLargeCanonicalPrimeProduct] using h.1
      · unfold HasCoreDensityAtMostThreeSixteenths at h
        omega
    · have h :=
        sectionElevenSectorOf_eq_six_iff.mp hsix
      refine ⟨?_, h.2.1, ?_⟩
      · simpa [HasLargeCanonicalPrimeProduct] using h.1
      · unfold HasCoreDensityAtMostThreeSixteenths at h
        omega
    · have h :=
        sectionElevenSectorOf_eq_seven_iff.mp hseven
      refine ⟨?_, h.2.1, ?_⟩
      · simpa [HasLargeCanonicalPrimeProduct] using h.1
      · unfold HasCoreDensityAtMostThreeSixteenths at h
        omega
  · rintro ⟨hlarge, hheight, hdepth⟩
    have hproduct :
        HasLargeCanonicalPrimeProduct A hN pair := by
      simpa [HasLargeCanonicalPrimeProduct] using hlarge
    have hdensity :
        ¬HasCoreDensityAtMostThreeSixteenths
          A L pair.1.1 pair.1.2 := by
      unfold HasCoreDensityAtMostThreeSixteenths
      omega
    by_cases haligned :
        IsCanonicallyAligned A L pair.1.1 pair.1.2
    · apply Or.inl
      apply Or.inl
      apply Or.inl
      exact sectionElevenSectorOf_eq_four_iff.mpr
        ⟨hproduct, hheight, hdensity, haligned⟩
    · have hnonaligned :
          IsCanonicallyNonaligned
            A L pair.1.1 pair.1.2 :=
        not_isCanonicallyAligned_iff_nonaligned.mp
          haligned
      by_cases hdefects :
          HasAtLeastThreeCorrectedDefects
            A L pair.1.1 pair.1.2
      · apply Or.inl
        apply Or.inl
        apply Or.inr
        exact sectionElevenSectorOf_eq_five_iff.mpr
          ⟨hproduct, hheight, hdensity, hnonaligned,
            hdefects⟩
      · have hfew :
            HasAtMostTwoCorrectedDefects
              A L pair.1.1 pair.1.2 :=
          not_atLeastThreeCorrectedDefects_iff_atMostTwo.mp
            hdefects
        by_cases hterminal : isTerminal pair
        · apply Or.inr
          exact sectionElevenSectorOf_eq_seven_iff.mpr
            ⟨hproduct, hheight, hdensity, hnonaligned,
              hfew, hterminal⟩
        · apply Or.inl
          apply Or.inr
          exact sectionElevenSectorOf_eq_six_iff.mpr
            ⟨hproduct, hheight, hdensity, hnonaligned,
              hfew, hterminal⟩

name: PaperC.CanonicalResidualComponents.canonicalResidualAmbient_admissibleCertificateSolutionMass_le
statement:
theorem canonicalResidualAmbient_admissibleCertificateSolutionMass_le
    {L a b N r : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    (hqTwo : 2 ≤ Nat.max a b)
    (hB : 4 ≤ L + 1)
    (hm : 2 ≤ (channelCells L a b h).card) :
    CRT.admissibleCertificateSolutionMass
        (Finset.univ :
          Finset (CanonicalResidualAmbientCell L a b h))
        r
        canonicalResidualAmbientLeftResidue
        canonicalResidualAmbientCellModulus
        N (2 * N) N 4 ≤
      (((2 * N : ℕ) : ℚ) *
        (((3584 : ℚ) * (L + 1 : ℚ) /
            (Nat.log 2 (L + 1) : ℚ)) ^ r /
          (r.factorial : ℚ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hlemma :=
    CRT.labeledCell_admissibleCertificateSolutionMass_le
      (canonicalResidualAmbientCells L a b h) r
      canonicalResidualAmbientLeftResidue
      canonicalResidualAmbientPrimeModulus
      canonicalResidualAmbientPrimeModulus_prime
      N (2 * N) 1 N
      (by omega) (by omega)
      4 (by norm_num)
  rw [sum_canonicalResidualAmbientCells_card_div_eq_residualPrimeMass]
    at hlemma
  have hlocal :
      CRT.admissibleCertificateSolutionMass
          (Finset.univ :
            Finset (CanonicalResidualAmbientCell L a b h))
          r
          canonicalResidualAmbientLeftResidue
          canonicalResidualAmbientCellModulus
          N (2 * N) N 4 ≤
        (((2 * N : ℕ) : ℚ) *
          (((4 : ℚ) * residualPrimeMass L a b h) ^ r /
            (r.factorial : ℚ))) := by
    exact hlemma
  have hmass :=
    ResidualChannelLemmaSevenTwo.residualPrimeMass_le
      ha hb hab hqTwo hB hm
  have hmassNonneg : 0 ≤ residualPrimeMass L a b h := by
    unfold residualPrimeMass
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro p hp
    apply div_nonneg
    · positivity
    · have hpPrime := (mem_residualPrimeRange.mp hp).1
      exact_mod_cast hpPrime.pos.le
  have hbase :
      (4 : ℚ) * residualPrimeMass L a b h ≤
        (3584 : ℚ) * (L + 1 : ℚ) /
          (Nat.log 2 (L + 1) : ℚ) := by
    calc
      (4 : ℚ) * residualPrimeMass L a b h ≤
          4 * (896 * (L + 1 : ℚ) /
            (Nat.log 2 (L + 1) : ℚ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmass (by norm_num)
      _ = (3584 : ℚ) * (L + 1 : ℚ) /
          (Nat.log 2 (L + 1) : ℚ) := by ring
  have hpow :
      ((4 : ℚ) * residualPrimeMass L a b h) ^ r ≤
        ((3584 : ℚ) * (L + 1 : ℚ) /
          (Nat.log 2 (L + 1) : ℚ)) ^ r :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hmassNonneg) hbase r
  exact hlocal.trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hpow (by positivity))
      (by positivity))

name: PaperC.CanonicalResidualComponents.sum_canonicalResidualAmbient_admissibleCertificateSolutionMass_le
statement:
theorem sum_canonicalResidualAmbient_admissibleCertificateSolutionMass_le
    {L a b N R : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    (hqTwo : 2 ≤ Nat.max a b)
    (hB : 4 ≤ L + 1)
    (hm : 2 ≤ (channelCells L a b h).card) :
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range R,
        CRT.admissibleCertificateSolutionMass
          (Finset.univ :
            Finset (CanonicalResidualAmbientCell L a b h))
          r
          canonicalResidualAmbientLeftResidue
          canonicalResidualAmbientCellModulus
          N (2 * N) N 4) ≤
      (((2 * N : ℕ) : ℚ) *
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.range R,
          ((3584 : ℚ) * (L + 1 : ℚ) /
              (Nat.log 2 (L + 1) : ℚ)) ^ r /
            (r.factorial : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range R,
        CRT.admissibleCertificateSolutionMass
          (Finset.univ :
            Finset (CanonicalResidualAmbientCell L a b h))
          r
          canonicalResidualAmbientLeftResidue
          canonicalResidualAmbientCellModulus
          N (2 * N) N 4) ≤
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.range R,
          (((2 * N : ℕ) : ℚ) *
            (((3584 : ℚ) * (L + 1 : ℚ) /
                (Nat.log 2 (L + 1) : ℚ)) ^ r /
              (r.factorial : ℚ))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro r _hr
      exact
        canonicalResidualAmbient_admissibleCertificateSolutionMass_le
          ha hb hab hqTwo hB hm
    _ = (((2 * N : ℕ) : ℚ) *
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.range R,
          ((3584 : ℚ) * (L + 1 : ℚ) /
              (Nat.log 2 (L + 1) : ℚ)) ^ r /
            (r.factorial : ℚ)) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: PaperC.CanonicalResidualComponents.sum_canonicalResidualAmbient_admissibleCertificateSolutionMass_cast_le_exp
statement:
theorem sum_canonicalResidualAmbient_admissibleCertificateSolutionMass_cast_le_exp
    {L a b N R : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    (hqTwo : 2 ≤ Nat.max a b)
    (hB : 4 ≤ L + 1)
    (hm : 2 ≤ (channelCells L a b h).card) :
    ((∑ r ∈ Finset.range R,
        CRT.admissibleCertificateSolutionMass
          (Finset.univ :
            Finset (CanonicalResidualAmbientCell L a b h))
          r
          canonicalResidualAmbientLeftResidue
          canonicalResidualAmbientCellModulus
          N (2 * N) N 4 : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤
      ((((2 * N : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℝ) *
        Real.exp
          (((3584 : ℚ) * (L + 1 : ℚ) /
            (Nat.log 2 (L + 1) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let base : ℚ :=
    (3584 : ℚ) * (L + 1 : ℚ) /
      (Nat.log 2 (L + 1) : ℚ)
  have hfinite :=
    sum_canonicalResidualAmbient_admissibleCertificateSolutionMass_le
      (N := N) (R := R) ha hb hab hqTwo hB hm
  have hfiniteCast :
      ((∑ r ∈ Finset.range R,
          CRT.admissibleCertificateSolutionMass
            (Finset.univ :
              Finset (CanonicalResidualAmbientCell L a b h))
            r
            canonicalResidualAmbientLeftResidue
            canonicalResidualAmbientCellModulus
            N (2 * N) N 4 : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤
        ((((2 * N : ℕ) : ℚ) *
          ∑ r ∈ Finset.range R,
            base ^ r / (r.factorial : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [base]
    exact_mod_cast hfinite
  have hbase : 0 ≤ base := by
    dsimp [base]
    apply div_nonneg
    · positivity
    · exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le (Nat.log 2 (L + 1))
  calc
    ((∑ r ∈ Finset.range R,
        CRT.admissibleCertificateSolutionMass
          (Finset.univ :
            Finset (CanonicalResidualAmbientCell L a b h))
          r
          canonicalResidualAmbientLeftResidue
          canonicalResidualAmbientCellModulus
          N (2 * N) N 4 : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤
        ((((2 * N : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℝ) *
          (((∑ r ∈ Finset.range R,
              base ^ r / (r.factorial : ℚ) : ℚ)) : ℝ)) := by
      simpa using hfiniteCast
    _ ≤ ((((2 * N : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (base : ℝ)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      · exact ratCast_sum_range_pow_div_factorial_le_exp
          base hbase R
      · positivity
    _ = ((((2 * N : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℝ) *
        Real.exp
          (((3584 : ℚ) * (L + 1 : ℚ) /
            (Nat.log 2 (L + 1) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) := by
      rfl

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker_eq_card
statement:
private theorem finrank_range_add_finrank_ker_eq_card
    {ι M : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module F₂ M]
    (f : (ι → F₂) →ₗ[F₂] M) :
    Module.finrank F₂ (LinearMap.range f) +
        Module.finrank F₂ (LinearMap.ker f) =
      Fintype.card ι
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Module.finrank F₂ (LinearMap.range f) +
          Module.finrank F₂ (LinearMap.ker f) =
        Module.finrank F₂ (ι → F₂) :=
      f.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
    _ = Fintype.card ι := Module.finrank_pi F₂

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.endpointVector_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem endpointVector_self (v : V) :

proof:
:= by
  ext w
  by_cases h : v = w <;>
    simp [endpointVector, Pi.single_apply, h] <;> decide

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.endpointVector_add_endpointVector
statement:
theorem endpointVector_add_endpointVector (u v w : V) :
    endpointVector u v + endpointVector v w = endpointVector u w
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [endpointVector, Pi.add_apply, Pi.single_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
  split_ifs <;> decide

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.incidenceVector_mem_range
statement:
theorem incidenceVector_mem_range
    (left right : E → V) (e : E) :
    incidenceVector left right e ∈ LinearMap.range (incidenceMap left right)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Pi.single e 1, ?_⟩
  rw [incidenceMap, Fintype.linearCombination_apply_single, one_smul]

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.endpointVector_mem_range_of_adjacent
statement:
theorem endpointVector_mem_range_of_adjacent
    (left right : E → V) {u v : V}
    (h : PresentedAdjacent left right u v) :
    endpointVector u v ∈ LinearMap.range (incidenceMap left right)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he | he⟩ := h
  · have hmem := incidenceVector_mem_range left right e
    simpa [endpointVector, incidenceVector, he.1, he.2] using hmem
  · have hmem := incidenceVector_mem_range left right e
    simpa [endpointVector, incidenceVector, he.1, he.2, add_comm] using hmem

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.endpointVector_mem_range_of_reachable
statement:
theorem endpointVector_mem_range_of_reachable
    (left right : E → V) {u v : V}
    (h : PresentedReachable left right u v) :
    endpointVector u v ∈ LinearMap.range (incidenceMap left right)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl =>
      rw [endpointVector_self]
      exact (LinearMap.range (incidenceMap left right)).zero_mem
  | tail huv hvw ih =>
      rw [← endpointVector_add_endpointVector]
      exact (LinearMap.range (incidenceMap left right)).add_mem ih
        (endpointVector_mem_range_of_adjacent left right hvw)

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.rootedEndpointVector_apply_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rootedEndpointVector_apply_self
    (component : V → C) (root : C → V)
    (v : NonRoot component root) :
    rootedEndpointVector component root v v.1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [rootedEndpointVector, endpointVector, v.2]

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.rootedEndpointVector_apply_ne
statement:
theorem rootedEndpointVector_apply_ne
    (component : V → C) (root : C → V)
    (hroot : ∀ c : C, component (root c) = c)
    (v w : NonRoot component root) (hwv : w ≠ v) :
    rootedEndpointVector component root w v.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hwv' : w.1 ≠ v.1 := by
    intro h
    exact hwv (Subtype.ext h)
  have hrootne : root (component w.1) ≠ v.1 := by
    intro h
    have hc : component v.1 = component w.1 := by
      rw [← h]
      exact hroot (component w.1)
    apply v.2
    rw [hc, h]
  simp [rootedEndpointVector, endpointVector, hwv', hrootne]

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.linearIndependent_rootedEndpointVector
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_rootedEndpointVector
    (component : V → C) (root : C → V)
    (hroot : ∀ c : C, component (root c) = c) :
    LinearIndependent F₂ (rootedEndpointVector component root)
proof:
:= by
  apply PrivatePivots.linearIndependent_of_private_pivots
    (R := F₂)
    (rootedEndpointVector component root)
    (fun v => (LinearMap.proj v.1 : (V → F₂) →ₗ[F₂] F₂))
  · intro v
    simp
  · intro v w hwv
    exact rootedEndpointVector_apply_ne component root hroot v w hwv

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.card_nonRoot
statement:
theorem card_nonRoot
    (component : V → C) (root : C → V)
    (hroot : ∀ c : C, component (root c) = c) :
    Fintype.card (NonRoot component root) =
      Fintype.card V - Fintype.card C
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl (fun v : V => v = root (component v))]
  congr 1
  exact Fintype.card_congr (rootVertexEquiv component root hroot).symm

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.card_vertices_sub_components_le_finrank_incidenceRange
statement:
theorem card_vertices_sub_components_le_finrank_incidenceRange
    (left right : E → V)
    (component : V → C) (root : C → V)
    (hroot : ∀ c : C, component (root c) = c)
    (hconnected :
      ∀ v : V, PresentedReachable left right (root (component v)) v) :
    Fintype.card V - Fintype.card C ≤
      Module.finrank F₂ (LinearMap.range (incidenceMap left right))
proof:
:= by
  let b := rootedEndpointVector component root
  have hb : LinearIndependent F₂ b :=
    linearIndependent_rootedEndpointVector component root hroot
  have hspan :
      Submodule.span F₂ (Set.range b) ≤
        LinearMap.range (incidenceMap left right) := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    have hpath := hconnected v.1
    have hmem :=
      endpointVector_mem_range_of_reachable left right hpath
    simpa [b, rootedEndpointVector, endpointVector, add_comm] using hmem
  rw [← card_nonRoot component root hroot, ← finrank_span_eq_card hb]
  exact Submodule.finrank_mono hspan

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.finrank_cycleSpace_le_card_edges_sub_nonRoot
statement:
theorem finrank_cycleSpace_le_card_edges_sub_nonRoot
    (left right : E → V)
    (component : V → C) (root : C → V)
    (hroot : ∀ c : C, component (root c) = c)
    (hconnected :
      ∀ v : V, PresentedReachable left right (root (component v)) v) :
    Module.finrank F₂ (cycleSpace left right) ≤
      Fintype.card E - (Fintype.card V - Fintype.card C)
proof:
:= by
  have hrange :=
    card_vertices_sub_components_le_finrank_incidenceRange
      left right component root hroot hconnected
  have hnullity :
      Module.finrank F₂ (LinearMap.range (incidenceMap left right)) +
          Module.finrank F₂ (LinearMap.ker (incidenceMap left right)) =
        Fintype.card E := by
    exact finrank_range_add_finrank_ker_eq_card (incidenceMap left right)
  rw [cycleSpace]
  omega

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.finrank_cycleSpace_le_cyclomaticNumber
statement:
theorem finrank_cycleSpace_le_cyclomaticNumber
    (left right : E → V)
    (component : V → C) (root : C → V)
    (hroot : ∀ c : C, component (root c) = c)
    (hconnected :
      ∀ v : V, PresentedReachable left right (root (component v)) v) :
    Module.finrank F₂ (cycleSpace left right) ≤
      Fintype.card E - Fintype.card V + Fintype.card C
proof:
:= by
  have hsafe :=
    finrank_cycleSpace_le_card_edges_sub_nonRoot
      left right component root hroot hconnected
  have hroot_injective : Function.Injective root := by
    intro c d hcd
    rw [← hroot c, ← hroot d, hcd]
  have hcardCV : Fintype.card C ≤ Fintype.card V :=
    Fintype.card_le_of_injective root hroot_injective
  omega

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.finrank_ker_representedEdgeMap_le_cyclomaticNumber
statement:
theorem finrank_ker_representedEdgeMap_le_cyclomaticNumber
    (vertexVector : V → P → F₂) (left right : E → V)
    (component : V → C) (root : C → V)
    (hroot : ∀ c : C, component (root c) = c)
    (hedge : ∀ e : E, component (left e) = component (right e))
    (hconnected :
      ∀ v : V, PresentedReachable left right (root (component v)) v)
    (hprivate : HasPrivatePivots vertexVector component root) :
    Module.finrank F₂
        (LinearMap.ker (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right)) ≤
      Fintype.card E - Fintype.card V + Fintype.card C
proof:
:=
  GraphCycleRank.finrank_ker_representedEdgeMap_le_cyclomaticNumber
    vertexVector left right component root hroot hedge hprivate
      (finrank_cycleSpace_le_cyclomaticNumber
        left right component root hroot hconnected)

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.finrank_ker_representedEdgeMap_le_card_edges_sub_nonRoot
statement:
theorem finrank_ker_representedEdgeMap_le_card_edges_sub_nonRoot
    (vertexVector : V → P → F₂) (left right : E → V)
    (component : V → C) (root : C → V)
    (hroot : ∀ c : C, component (root c) = c)
    (hedge : ∀ e : E, component (left e) = component (right e))
    (hconnected :
      ∀ v : V, PresentedReachable left right (root (component v)) v)
    (hprivate : HasPrivatePivots vertexVector component root) :
    Module.finrank F₂
        (LinearMap.ker (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right)) ≤
      Fintype.card E - (Fintype.card V - Fintype.card C)
proof:
:=
  (GraphCycleRank.finrank_ker_representedEdgeMap_le_cycleSpace
      vertexVector left right component root hroot hedge hprivate).trans
    (finrank_cycleSpace_le_card_edges_sub_nonRoot
      left right component root hroot hconnected)

name: PaperC.CycleSpaceDimension.card_vertices_sub_components_le_rank_representedEdgeMap
statement:
theorem card_vertices_sub_components_le_rank_representedEdgeMap
    (vertexVector : V → P → F₂) (left right : E → V)
    (component : V → C) (root : C → V)
    (hroot : ∀ c : C, component (root c) = c)
    (hedge : ∀ e : E, component (left e) = component (right e))
    (hconnected :
      ∀ v : V, PresentedReachable left right (root (component v)) v)
    (hprivate : HasPrivatePivots vertexVector component root) :
    Fintype.card V - Fintype.card C ≤
      Module.finrank F₂
        (LinearMap.range (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right))
proof:
:= by
  have hker :=
    finrank_ker_representedEdgeMap_le_card_edges_sub_nonRoot
      vertexVector left right component root hroot hedge hconnected hprivate
  have hnullity :
      Module.finrank F₂
          (LinearMap.range (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right)) +
          Module.finrank F₂
          (LinearMap.ker (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right)) =
        Fintype.card E := by
    exact finrank_range_add_finrank_ker_eq_card
      (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right)
  have hincRange :
      Fintype.card V - Fintype.card C ≤
        Module.finrank F₂ (LinearMap.range (incidenceMap left right)) :=
    card_vertices_sub_components_le_finrank_incidenceRange
      left right component root hroot hconnected
  have hincNullity :
      Module.finrank F₂ (LinearMap.range (incidenceMap left right)) +
          Module.finrank F₂ (LinearMap.ker (incidenceMap left right)) =
        Fintype.card E :=
    finrank_range_add_finrank_ker_eq_card (incidenceMap left right)
  have hcardEV :
      Fintype.card V - Fintype.card C ≤ Fintype.card E := by
    omega
  have hsum :
      Module.finrank F₂
            (LinearMap.ker (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right)) +
          (Fintype.card V - Fintype.card C) ≤
        Fintype.card E :=
    Nat.add_le_of_le_sub hcardEV hker
  have hcancel :
      Module.finrank F₂
            (LinearMap.ker (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right)) +
          (Fintype.card V - Fintype.card C) ≤
        Module.finrank F₂
            (LinearMap.ker (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right)) +
          Module.finrank F₂
            (LinearMap.range (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right)) := by
    calc
      Module.finrank F₂
              (LinearMap.ker (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right)) +
            (Fintype.card V - Fintype.card C) ≤
          Fintype.card E := hsum
      _ =
          Module.finrank F₂
              (LinearMap.range (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right)) +
            Module.finrank F₂
              (LinearMap.ker (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right)) :=
        hnullity.symm
      _ =
          Module.finrank F₂
              (LinearMap.ker (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right)) +
            Module.finrank F₂
              (LinearMap.range (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right)) :=
        Nat.add_comm _ _
  exact Nat.le_of_add_le_add_left hcancel

name: PaperC.SmallHeightTauEnvelope.pairTau_le_smallHeightTauEnvelope_of_mem
statement:
theorem pairTau_le_smallHeightTauEnvelope_of_mem
    {N A L : ℕ} {hN : 2 ≤ N}
    (hB : 8 ≤ L + 1)
    {pair : SeparatedDyadicPair N L}
    (hpair :
      pair ∈ smallHeightLargeProductPairs N A L hN) :
    pairTau A hN pair ≤
      smallHeightTauEnvelope A N L
proof:
:= by
  have htau :=
    pairTau_le_canonicalCorrected_add_residual
      (A := A) hN pair
  have hcorrected :
      canonicalCorrectedDefectCount
          A pair.1.1 pair.1.2 L ≤
        CorrectedDefectEnvelope.maxCanonicalCorrectedDefectCount
          A N L :=
    CorrectedDefectEnvelope.canonicalCorrectedDefectCount_le_max
      pair.2
  have hresidual :
      canonicalResidualComponentCount
          A pair.1.1 pair.1.2 L ≤
        smallHeightResidualComponentEnvelope L := by
    simpa only [pairResidualComponentCount] using
      pairResidualComponentCount_le_envelope_of_mem
        hB hpair
  exact htau.trans <| by
    unfold smallHeightTauEnvelope
    exact Nat.add_le_add hcorrected hresidual

name: PaperC.SmallHeightTauEnvelope.four_pow_pairTau_le_canonicalCorrected_mul_residual
statement:
theorem four_pow_pairTau_le_canonicalCorrected_mul_residual
    {N A L : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (pair : SeparatedDyadicPair N L) :
    4 ^ pairTau A hN pair ≤
      4 ^ canonicalCorrectedDefectCount
          A pair.1.1 pair.1.2 L *
        4 ^ canonicalResidualComponentCount
          A pair.1.1 pair.1.2 L
proof:
:= by
  have htau :=
    pairTau_le_canonicalCorrected_add_residual
      (A := A) hN pair
  calc
    4 ^ pairTau A hN pair ≤
        4 ^
          (canonicalCorrectedDefectCount
              A pair.1.1 pair.1.2 L +
            canonicalResidualComponentCount
              A pair.1.1 pair.1.2 L) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) htau
    _ =
        4 ^ canonicalCorrectedDefectCount
            A pair.1.1 pair.1.2 L *
          4 ^ canonicalResidualComponentCount
            A pair.1.1 pair.1.2 L := by
      rw [pow_add]

name: PaperC.SmallHeightTauEnvelope.four_pow_smallHeightTauEnvelope_eq
statement:
theorem four_pow_smallHeightTauEnvelope_eq
    (A N L : ℕ) :
    4 ^ smallHeightTauEnvelope A N L =
      4 ^ CorrectedDefectEnvelope.maxCanonicalCorrectedDefectCount
          A N L *
        4 ^ smallHeightResidualComponentEnvelope L
proof:
:= by
  rw [smallHeightTauEnvelope, pow_add]

name: PaperC.SmallHeightTauEnvelope.four_pow_pairTau_le_four_pow_smallHeightTauEnvelope_of_mem
statement:
theorem four_pow_pairTau_le_four_pow_smallHeightTauEnvelope_of_mem
    {N A L : ℕ} {hN : 2 ≤ N}
    (hB : 8 ≤ L + 1)
    {pair : SeparatedDyadicPair N L}
    (hpair :
      pair ∈ smallHeightLargeProductPairs N A L hN) :
    4 ^ pairTau A hN pair ≤
      4 ^ smallHeightTauEnvelope A N L
proof:
:=
  Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num)
    (pairTau_le_smallHeightTauEnvelope_of_mem hB hpair)

name: PaperC.SmallHeightTauEnvelope.four_pow_pairTau_le_maxCorrected_mul_residualEnvelope_of_mem
statement:
theorem four_pow_pairTau_le_maxCorrected_mul_residualEnvelope_of_mem
    {N A L : ℕ} {hN : 2 ≤ N}
    (hB : 8 ≤ L + 1)
    {pair : SeparatedDyadicPair N L}
    (hpair :
      pair ∈ smallHeightLargeProductPairs N A L hN) :
    4 ^ pairTau A hN pair ≤
      4 ^ CorrectedDefectEnvelope.maxCanonicalCorrectedDefectCount
          A N L *
        4 ^ smallHeightResidualComponentEnvelope L
proof:
:= by
  rw [← four_pow_smallHeightTauEnvelope_eq]
  exact
    four_pow_pairTau_le_four_pow_smallHeightTauEnvelope_of_mem
      hB hpair

name: PaperC.IntervalDefectAggregation.mem_defectsInInterval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_defectsInInterval
    {defects : Finset ℕ} {H u n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ defectsInInterval defects H u ↔
      n ∈ defects ∧ u ≤ n ∧ n ≤ u + H
proof:
:= by
  simp [defectsInInterval]

name: PaperC.IntervalDefectAggregation.sum_localCount_eq_sum_intervalStartsContaining
statement:
theorem sum_localCount_eq_sum_intervalStartsContaining
    (defects starts : Finset ℕ) (H : ℕ) :
    ∑ u ∈ starts, localCount defects H u =
      ∑ n ∈ defects,
        (DefectCounting.intervalStartsContaining starts H n).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [localCount, defectsInInterval, Finset.card_eq_sum_ones,
    DefectCounting.intervalStartsContaining]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: PaperC.IntervalDefectAggregation.sum_localCount_le
statement:
theorem sum_localCount_le
    (defects starts : Finset ℕ) (H : ℕ) :
    ∑ u ∈ starts, localCount defects H u ≤
      (H + 1) * defects.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_localCount_eq_sum_intervalStartsContaining]
  calc
    ∑ n ∈ defects,
        (DefectCounting.intervalStartsContaining starts H n).card
        ≤ ∑ _n ∈ defects, (H + 1) := by
          exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun n _hn ↦
            DefectCounting.card_intervalStartsContaining_le starts H n
    _ = (H + 1) * defects.card := by
      simp [Nat.mul_comm]

name: PaperC.IntervalDefectAggregation.two_pow_sub_one_le_mul
statement:
theorem two_pow_sub_one_le_mul
    {m M : ℕ} (hmM : m ≤ M) :
    2 ^ m - 1 ≤ m * 2 ^ M
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m =>
      calc
        2 ^ (m + 1) - 1 ≤ 2 ^ (m + 1) := Nat.sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ 2 ^ M := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hmM
        _ = 1 * 2 ^ M := by simp
        _ ≤ (m + 1) * 2 ^ M := by
          simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using
            Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left (2 ^ M) (Nat.succ_pos m)

name: PaperC.IntervalDefectAggregation.sum_two_pow_localCount_sub_one_le
statement:
theorem sum_two_pow_localCount_sub_one_le
    (defects starts : Finset ℕ) (H M : ℕ)
    (hlocal : ∀ u ∈ starts, localCount defects H u ≤ M) :
    ∑ u ∈ starts, (2 ^ localCount defects H u - 1) ≤
      (H + 1) * defects.card * 2 ^ M
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ∑ u ∈ starts, (2 ^ localCount defects H u - 1)
        ≤ ∑ u ∈ starts, localCount defects H u * 2 ^ M := by
          exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun u hu ↦
            two_pow_sub_one_le_mul (hlocal u hu)
    _ = (∑ u ∈ starts, localCount defects H u) * 2 ^ M := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ ≤ ((H + 1) * defects.card) * 2 ^ M :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ M) (sum_localCount_le defects starts H)

name: PaperC.TouchingPairs.mem_touchingPairs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_touchingPairs {N L x y : ℕ} :
    (x, y) ∈ touchingPairs N L ↔
      x ∈ dyadicBlock N ∧ y ∈ dyadicBlock N ∧ Nat.dist x y = L
proof:
:= by
  simp only [touchingPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
  tauto

name: PaperC.TouchingPairs.eq_add_or_eq_add_of_dist_eq
statement:
theorem eq_add_or_eq_add_of_dist_eq
    {x y L : ℕ} (hdist : Nat.dist x y = L) :
    y = x + L ∨ x = y + L
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : x ≤ y
  · left
    rw [Nat.dist_eq_sub_of_le hxy] at hdist
    omega
  · right
    have hyx : y ≤ x := Nat.le_of_not_ge hxy
    rw [Nat.dist_eq_sub_of_le_right hyx] at hdist
    omega

name: PaperC.TouchingPairs.fst_ne_snd_of_mem
statement:
theorem fst_ne_snd_of_mem
    {N L : ℕ} {pair : ℕ × ℕ} (hL : 0 < L)
    (hpair : pair ∈ touchingPairs N L) :
    pair.1 ≠ pair.2
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hdist := (mem_touchingPairs.mp hpair).2.2
  rw [heq, Nat.dist_self] at hdist
  omega

name: PaperC.TouchingPairs.touchingPairs_subset_candidates
statement:
theorem touchingPairs_subset_candidates (N L : ℕ) :
    touchingPairs N L ⊆
      forwardCandidates N L ∪ backwardCandidates N L
proof:
:= by
  intro pair hpair
  obtain ⟨hx, hy, hdist⟩ := mem_touchingPairs.mp hpair
  rcases eq_add_or_eq_add_of_dist_eq hdist with hforward | hbackward
  · apply Finset.mem_union_left
    rw [forwardCandidates, Finset.mem_image]
    exact ⟨pair.1, hx, by
      apply Prod.ext
      · rfl
      · exact hforward.symm⟩
  · apply Finset.mem_union_right
    rw [backwardCandidates, Finset.mem_image]
    exact ⟨pair.2, hy, by
      apply Prod.ext
      · exact hbackward.symm
      · rfl⟩

name: PaperC.TouchingPairs.card_forwardCandidates_le
statement:
theorem card_forwardCandidates_le (N L : ℕ) :
    (forwardCandidates N L).card ≤ (dyadicBlock N).card
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.card_image_le

name: PaperC.TouchingPairs.card_backwardCandidates_le
statement:
theorem card_backwardCandidates_le (N L : ℕ) :
    (backwardCandidates N L).card ≤ (dyadicBlock N).card
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.card_image_le

name: PaperC.TouchingPairs.card_touchingPairs_le_two_mul_card
statement:
theorem card_touchingPairs_le_two_mul_card (N L : ℕ) :
    (touchingPairs N L).card ≤ 2 * (dyadicBlock N).card
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (touchingPairs N L).card ≤
        (forwardCandidates N L ∪ backwardCandidates N L).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card (touchingPairs_subset_candidates N L)
    _ ≤ (forwardCandidates N L).card +
        (backwardCandidates N L).card :=
      Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ (dyadicBlock N).card + (dyadicBlock N).card :=
      Nat.add_le_add
        (card_forwardCandidates_le N L)
        (card_backwardCandidates_le N L)
    _ = 2 * (dyadicBlock N).card := by omega

name: PaperC.TouchingPairs.card_dyadicBlock
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_dyadicBlock (N : ℕ) :
    (dyadicBlock N).card = N
proof:
:= by
  simp [dyadicBlock]
  omega

name: PaperC.TouchingPairs.card_touchingPairs_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem card_touchingPairs_le_two_mul (N L : ℕ) :
    (touchingPairs N L).card ≤ 2 * N
proof:
:= by
  simpa using card_touchingPairs_le_two_mul_card N L

name: PaperC.TouchingPairs.sum_nat_le_card_mul
statement:
theorem sum_nat_le_card_mul
    (N L W : ℕ) (weight : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ)
    (hweight : ∀ pair ∈ touchingPairs N L, weight pair ≤ W) :
    ∑ pair ∈ touchingPairs N L, weight pair ≤
      (touchingPairs N L).card * W
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ∑ pair ∈ touchingPairs N L, weight pair ≤
        ∑ _pair ∈ touchingPairs N L, W :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun pair hpair ↦ hweight pair hpair
    _ = (touchingPairs N L).card * W := by simp

name: PaperC.TouchingPairs.sum_nat_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem sum_nat_le_two_mul
    (N L W : ℕ) (weight : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ)
    (hweight : ∀ pair ∈ touchingPairs N L, weight pair ≤ W) :
    ∑ pair ∈ touchingPairs N L, weight pair ≤
      (2 * N) * W
proof:
:= by
  exact (sum_nat_le_card_mul N L W weight hweight).trans
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_right W (card_touchingPairs_le_two_mul N L))

name: PaperC.TouchingPairs.sum_real_le_card_mul
statement:
theorem sum_real_le_card_mul
    (N L : ℕ) (W : ℝ) (weight : ℕ × ℕ → ℝ)
    (hweight : ∀ pair ∈ touchingPairs N L, weight pair ≤ W) :
    ∑ pair ∈ touchingPairs N L, weight pair ≤
      ((touchingPairs N L).card : ℝ) * W
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ∑ pair ∈ touchingPairs N L, weight pair ≤
        ∑ _pair ∈ touchingPairs N L, W :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun pair hpair ↦ hweight pair hpair
    _ = ((touchingPairs N L).card : ℝ) * W := by simp

name: PaperC.TouchingPairs.sum_real_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem sum_real_le_two_mul
    (N L : ℕ) (W : ℝ) (weight : ℕ × ℕ → ℝ)
    (hW : 0 ≤ W)
    (hweight : ∀ pair ∈ touchingPairs N L, weight pair ≤ W) :
    ∑ pair ∈ touchingPairs N L, weight pair ≤
      (2 * N : ℝ) * W
proof:
:= by
  refine (sum_real_le_card_mul N L W weight hweight).trans ?_
  gcongr
  exact_mod_cast card_touchingPairs_le_two_mul N L

name: PaperC.LargePrimeComponents.mem_componentVertices
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_componentVertices
    {x y L : ℕ}
    {C : (largePrimeGraph x y L).ConnectedComponent}
    {v : Occurrence L} :
    v ∈ componentVertices x y L C ↔
      (largePrimeGraph x y L).connectedComponentMk v = C
proof:
:= by

name: PaperC.LargePrimeComponents.componentVertices_nonempty
statement:
theorem componentVertices_nonempty
    (x y L : ℕ)
    (C : (largePrimeGraph x y L).ConnectedComponent) :
    (componentVertices x y L C).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := C.exists_rep
  refine ⟨v, ?_⟩

  change Quot.mk (largePrimeGraph x y L).Reachable v = C

name: PaperC.LargePrimeComponents.startCompleteVertexLabel_lower
statement:
theorem startCompleteVertexLabel_lower
    {x L : ℕ} (hx : 1 ≤ x)
    (v : Fin (L + 1)) :
    x - 1 ≤ Affine.startCompleteVertexLabel x L v
proof:
:= by
  unfold Affine.startCompleteVertexLabel
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: PaperC.LargePrimeComponents.startCompleteVertexLabel_upper
statement:
theorem startCompleteVertexLabel_upper
    {x L : ℕ} (hx : 1 ≤ x)

proof:
:= by
