    simpa [SatisfiesChannelInequality, pairChannelError, abs_lt]
      using hclose
  constructor
  · rw [Finset.mem_Ico]
    constructor <;> omega
  · rw [Finset.mem_Ico]
    constructor
    · exact hyBounds.1
    · omega

name: PaperC.heightTwoForwardPairs_subset_rectangle
statement:
theorem heightTwoForwardPairs_subset_rectangle (N B : ℕ) :
    heightTwoForwardPairs N B ⊆
      Ico N (N + 3 * B) ×ˢ Ico (2 * N - 3 * B) (2 * N)
proof:
:= by
  intro pair hpair
  rcases pair with ⟨x, y⟩
  exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
    (heightTwoForwardPairs_confinement hpair)

name: PaperC.heightTwoBackwardPairs_subset_rectangle
statement:
theorem heightTwoBackwardPairs_subset_rectangle (N B : ℕ) :
    heightTwoBackwardPairs N B ⊆
      Ico (2 * N - 3 * B) (2 * N) ×ˢ Ico N (N + 3 * B)
proof:
:= by
  intro pair hpair
  rcases pair with ⟨x, y⟩
  exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
    (heightTwoBackwardPairs_confinement hpair)

name: PaperC.card_heightTwoForwardPairs_le
statement:
theorem card_heightTwoForwardPairs_le (N B : ℕ) :
    (heightTwoForwardPairs N B).card ≤ (3 * B) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset :=
    Finset.card_le_card (heightTwoForwardPairs_subset_rectangle N B)
  have hlast :
      (Ico (2 * N - 3 * B) (2 * N)).card ≤ 3 * B := by
    simp only [Nat.card_Ico]
    omega
  calc
    (heightTwoForwardPairs N B).card ≤
        (Ico N (N + 3 * B) ×ˢ
          Ico (2 * N - 3 * B) (2 * N)).card :=
      hsubset
    _ = (3 * B) *
        (Ico (2 * N - 3 * B) (2 * N)).card := by
      rw [Finset.card_product]
      simp
    _ ≤ (3 * B) * (3 * B) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left (3 * B) hlast
    _ = (3 * B) ^ 2 := by ring

name: PaperC.card_heightTwoBackwardPairs_le
statement:
theorem card_heightTwoBackwardPairs_le (N B : ℕ) :
    (heightTwoBackwardPairs N B).card ≤ (3 * B) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset :=
    Finset.card_le_card (heightTwoBackwardPairs_subset_rectangle N B)
  have hlast :
      (Ico (2 * N - 3 * B) (2 * N)).card ≤ 3 * B := by
    simp only [Nat.card_Ico]
    omega
  calc
    (heightTwoBackwardPairs N B).card ≤
        (Ico (2 * N - 3 * B) (2 * N) ×ˢ
          Ico N (N + 3 * B)).card :=
      hsubset
    _ = (Ico (2 * N - 3 * B) (2 * N)).card *
        (3 * B) := by
      rw [Finset.card_product]
      simp
    _ ≤ (3 * B) * (3 * B) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right (3 * B) hlast
    _ = (3 * B) ^ 2 := by ring

name: PaperC.card_heightTwoBoundaryPairs_le
statement:
theorem card_heightTwoBoundaryPairs_le (N B : ℕ) :
    (heightTwoBoundaryPairs N B).card ≤
      2 * (6 * B + 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hunion :
      (heightTwoBoundaryPairs N B).card ≤
        (heightTwoForwardPairs N B).card +
          (heightTwoBackwardPairs N B).card := by
    exact Finset.card_union_le _ _
  have horiented :
      (heightTwoForwardPairs N B).card +
          (heightTwoBackwardPairs N B).card ≤
        2 * (3 * B) ^ 2 := by
    have hforward := card_heightTwoForwardPairs_le N B
    have hbackward := card_heightTwoBackwardPairs_le N B
    omega
  have hbase : 3 * B ≤ 6 * B + 1 := by
    omega
  have hsquare :
      (3 * B) ^ 2 ≤ (6 * B + 1) ^ 2 :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_left hbase 2
  exact hunion.trans <| horiented.trans <|
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hsquare

name: PaperC.residualPrimeMass_le
statement:
theorem residualPrimeMass_le
    (P : Finset ℕ) (E : ℕ → ℚ) (C q B : ℚ)
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, 0 < p)
    (hpointwise :
      ∀ p ∈ P,
        E p ≤
          C * (1 + q * B / (p : ℚ)) * (1 + B / q)) :
    ∑ p ∈ P, E p / (p : ℚ) ≤
      C * (1 + B / q) *
        ((∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℚ) / (p : ℚ)) +
          q * B * ∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℚ) / (p : ℚ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ∑ p ∈ P, E p / (p : ℚ) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ P,
          (C * (1 + q * B / (p : ℚ)) *
              (1 + B / q)) / (p : ℚ) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun p hp ↦
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
          (hpointwise p hp) (by positivity)
    _ = ∑ p ∈ P,
          C * (1 + B / q) *
            ((1 : ℚ) / (p : ℚ) +
              q * B * ((1 : ℚ) / (p : ℚ) ^ 2)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      have hp0 : (p : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (hP p hp).ne'
      field_simp [hp0]
    _ = C * (1 + B / q) *
        ((∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℚ) / (p : ℚ)) +
          q * B * ∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℚ) / (p : ℚ) ^ 2) := by
      simp_rw [mul_add]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp only [← Finset.mul_sum]

name: PaperC.residualPrimeMass_natCast_le
statement:
theorem residualPrimeMass_natCast_le
    (P : Finset ℕ) (E : ℕ → ℕ) (C q B : ℚ)
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, 0 < p)
    (hpointwise :
      ∀ p ∈ P,
        (E p : ℚ) ≤
          C * (1 + q * B / (p : ℚ)) * (1 + B / q)) :
    ∑ p ∈ P, (E p : ℚ) / (p : ℚ) ≤
      C * (1 + B / q) *
        ((∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℚ) / (p : ℚ)) +
          q * B * ∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℚ) / (p : ℚ) ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  residualPrimeMass_le P (fun p ↦ (E p : ℚ))
    C q B hP hpointwise

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.card_primes
statement:
private theorem card_primes (H : ℕ) :
    (primes H).card = PrimesUpTo.count H
proof:
:= by
  exact (PrimeCountBridge.count_eq_card_smallPrimesUpTo H).symm

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.card_lowPrimes_le
statement:
private theorem card_lowPrimes_le (H : ℕ) :
    (lowPrimes H).card ≤ cutoff H
proof:
:= by
  refine (Finset.card_le_card ?_).trans_eq (Finset.card_range _)
  intro p hp
  exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.highPrimes_subset_primes
statement:
private theorem highPrimes_subset_primes (H : ℕ) :
    highPrimes H ⊆ primes H
proof:
:=
  Finset.filter_subset _ _

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.cutoff_pow_card_highPrimes_le_primorial
statement:
private theorem cutoff_pow_card_highPrimes_le_primorial (H : ℕ) :
    cutoff H ^ (highPrimes H).card ≤ primorial H
proof:
:= by
  calc
    cutoff H ^ (highPrimes H).card
        ≤ ∏ p ∈ highPrimes H, p := by
          apply Finset.pow_card_le_prod
          intro p hp
          exact Nat.le_of_not_gt (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
    _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ primes H, p := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le'
      · exact highPrimes_subset_primes H
      · intro p hp _
        exact (DefectCounting.mem_smallPrimesUpTo.mp hp).1.one_lt.le
    _ = primorial H := by
      simp [primes, DefectCounting.smallPrimesUpTo, primorial]

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.halfLog_mul_card_highPrimes_le
statement:
theorem halfLog_mul_card_highPrimes_le (H : ℕ) :
    (Nat.log 2 H / 2) * (highPrimes H).card ≤ 2 * H
proof:
:= by
  have hpow :
      2 ^ ((Nat.log 2 H / 2) * (highPrimes H).card) ≤
        2 ^ (2 * H) := by
    calc
      2 ^ ((Nat.log 2 H / 2) * (highPrimes H).card)
          = cutoff H ^ (highPrimes H).card := by
            simp [cutoff, pow_mul]
      _ ≤ primorial H := cutoff_pow_card_highPrimes_le_primorial H
      _ ≤ 4 ^ H := primorial_le_four_pow H
      _ = 2 ^ (2 * H) := by norm_num [pow_mul]
  exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right (by omega : 1 < 2)).mp hpow

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.card_highPrimes_le_div
proof:
:= by
  apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hq).mpr
  simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using halfLog_mul_card_highPrimes_le H

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.card_low_add_card_high
statement:
private theorem card_low_add_card_high (H : ℕ) :
    (lowPrimes H).card + (highPrimes H).card = (primes H).card
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s := primes H) (fun p ↦ p < cutoff H)

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.count_le_pow_halfLog_add_div
statement:
theorem count_le_pow_halfLog_add_div (H : ℕ)
    (hq : 0 < Nat.log 2 H / 2) :
    PrimesUpTo.count H ≤
      2 ^ (Nat.log 2 H / 2) + (2 * H) / (Nat.log 2 H / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_primes H, ← card_low_add_card_high H]
  exact Nat.add_le_add (card_lowPrimes_le H) (card_highPrimes_le_div H hq)

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.count_le_pow_halfLog_add_div_of_four_le
statement:
theorem count_le_pow_halfLog_add_div_of_four_le {H : ℕ} (hH : 4 ≤ H) :
    PrimesUpTo.count H ≤
      2 ^ (Nat.log 2 H / 2) + (2 * H) / (Nat.log 2 H / 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply count_le_pow_halfLog_add_div H
  have hlog : 2 ≤ Nat.log 2 H := by
    apply Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by omega)
    norm_num at hH ⊢
    exact hH
  omega

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.two_mul_add_one_le_two_pow_succ
statement:
private theorem two_mul_add_one_le_two_pow_succ :
    ∀ q : ℕ, 2 * q + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (q + 1)
proof:
| 0 => by norm_num
  | 1 => by norm_num
  | q + 2 => by
      have ih := two_mul_add_one_le_two_pow_succ (q + 1)
      calc
        2 * (q + 2) + 1 ≤ 2 * (2 * (q + 1) + 1) := by omega
        _ ≤ 2 * 2 ^ (q + 1 + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 ih
        _ = 2 ^ (q + 2 + 1) := by
          simp only [pow_add, pow_one]
          ring

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.card_highPrimes_le
statement:
private theorem card_highPrimes_le (H : ℕ) :
    (highPrimes H).card ≤ H
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (highPrimes H).card ≤ (Finset.Icc 1 H).card := by
      apply Finset.card_le_card
      intro p hp
      have hp' :=
        DefectCounting.mem_smallPrimesUpTo.mp
          (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
      exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hp'.1.pos, hp'.2⟩
    _ = H := by simp

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.log_mul_card_lowPrimes_le
statement:
private theorem log_mul_card_lowPrimes_le {H : ℕ} (hH : 4 ≤ H) :
    Nat.log 2 H * (lowPrimes H).card ≤ 2 * H
proof:
:= by
  let L := Nat.log 2 H
  let q := L / 2
  have hLq_upper : L ≤ 2 * q + 1 := by
    dsimp [q]
    omega
  have hqL : 2 * q ≤ L := by
    dsimp [q]
    omega
  have hLK : L * 2 ^ q ≤ 2 ^ (L + 1) := by
    calc
      L * 2 ^ q ≤ (2 * q + 1) * 2 ^ q :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ q) hLq_upper
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (q + 1) * 2 ^ q :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ q) (two_mul_add_one_le_two_pow_succ q)
      _ = 2 ^ (2 * q + 1) := by
        rw [← pow_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (L + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
  have hpow : 2 ^ L ≤ H := by
    apply Nat.pow_log_le_self
    omega
  calc
    Nat.log 2 H * (lowPrimes H).card
        ≤ L * 2 ^ q := by
          dsimp [L, q]
          exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (card_lowPrimes_le H)
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (L + 1) := hLK
    _ = 2 * 2 ^ L := by rw [pow_succ]; omega
    _ ≤ 2 * H := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hpow

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.log_mul_card_highPrimes_le
statement:
private theorem log_mul_card_highPrimes_le (H : ℕ) :
    Nat.log 2 H * (highPrimes H).card ≤ 5 * H
proof:
:= by
  let L := Nat.log 2 H
  let q := L / 2
  let m := (highPrimes H).card
  have hLq : L ≤ 2 * q + 1 := by
    dsimp [q]
    omega
  have hqm : q * m ≤ 2 * H := by
    simpa [q, m, L] using halfLog_mul_card_highPrimes_le H
  have hm : m ≤ H := by
    simpa [m] using card_highPrimes_le H
  calc
    Nat.log 2 H * (highPrimes H).card = L * m := rfl
    _ ≤ (2 * q + 1) * m := Nat.mul_le_mul_right m hLq
    _ = 2 * (q * m) + m := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 * (2 * H) + H :=
      Nat.add_le_add (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hqm) hm
    _ = 5 * H := by omega

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.log_mul_count_le_seven_mul
statement:
theorem log_mul_count_le_seven_mul {H : ℕ} (hH : 4 ≤ H) :
    Nat.log 2 H * PrimesUpTo.count H ≤ 7 * H
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_primes H, ← card_low_add_card_high H, Nat.mul_add]
  calc
    Nat.log 2 H * (lowPrimes H).card +
          Nat.log 2 H * (highPrimes H).card
        ≤ 2 * H + 5 * H :=
      Nat.add_le_add (log_mul_card_lowPrimes_le hH)
        (log_mul_card_highPrimes_le H)
    _ = 7 * H := by omega

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.count_le_seven_mul_div_log
statement:
theorem count_le_seven_mul_div_log {H : ℕ} (hH : 4 ≤ H) :
    PrimesUpTo.count H ≤ (7 * H) / Nat.log 2 H
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : 0 < Nat.log 2 H := by
    have : 2 ≤ Nat.log 2 H := by
      apply Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by omega)
      norm_num at hH ⊢
      exact hH
    omega
  apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hlog).mpr
  simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using log_mul_count_le_seven_mul hH

name: PaperC.mem_offsetInterval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_offsetInterval {L : ℕ} {i : ℤ} :
    i ∈ offsetInterval L ↔ -1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ (L : ℤ) - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [offsetInterval]

name: PaperC.mem_offsetBox
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_offsetBox {L : ℕ} {cell : ℤ × ℤ} :
    cell ∈ offsetBox L ↔
      (-1 ≤ cell.1 ∧ cell.1 ≤ (L : ℤ) - 1) ∧
      (-1 ≤ cell.2 ∧ cell.2 ≤ (L : ℤ) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [offsetBox]

name: PaperC.mem_channelCells
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_channelCells {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ} {cell : ℤ × ℤ} :
    cell ∈ channelCells L a b h ↔
      cell ∈ offsetBox L ∧ OnChannel a b h cell
proof:
:= by
  simp [channelCells]

name: PaperC.channel_difference_identity
statement:
theorem channel_difference_identity
    {a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ} {cell₁ cell₂ : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h₁ : OnChannel a b h cell₁)
    (h₂ : OnChannel a b h cell₂) :
    (a : ℤ) * (cell₁.1 - cell₂.1) =
      (b : ℤ) * (cell₁.2 - cell₂.2)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [OnChannel] at h₁ h₂
  linarith

name: PaperC.channel_difference_eq_multiple
statement:
theorem channel_difference_eq_multiple
    {a b : ℕ} (_ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    {h : ℤ} {cell₁ cell₂ : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h₁ : OnChannel a b h cell₁)
    (h₂ : OnChannel a b h cell₂) :
    ∃ t : ℤ,
      cell₁.1 - cell₂.1 = (b : ℤ) * t ∧
      cell₁.2 - cell₂.2 = (a : ℤ) * t
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff := channel_difference_identity h₁ h₂
  have hb_mul :
      (b : ℤ) ∣ (a : ℤ) * (cell₁.1 - cell₂.1) := by
    refine ⟨cell₁.2 - cell₂.2, ?_⟩
    exact hdiff
  have hb :
      (b : ℤ) ∣ cell₁.1 - cell₂.1 :=
    hab.symm.isCoprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hb_mul
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
  have hbcast : (b : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hb.ne'
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hbcast
  calc
    (b : ℤ) * (cell₁.2 - cell₂.2) =
        (a : ℤ) * (cell₁.1 - cell₂.1) := hdiff.symm
    _ = (a : ℤ) * ((b : ℤ) * t) := by rw [ht]
    _ = (b : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) * t) := by ring

name: PaperC.abs_sub_le_of_mem_offsetInterval
statement:
theorem abs_sub_le_of_mem_offsetInterval
    {L : ℕ} {i₁ i₂ : ℤ}
    (h₁ : i₁ ∈ offsetInterval L)
    (h₂ : i₂ ∈ offsetInterval L) :
    |i₁ - i₂| ≤ (L : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_le]
  simp only [mem_offsetInterval] at h₁ h₂
  omega

name: PaperC.channel_coefficients_le_length
statement:
theorem channel_coefficients_le_length
    {L a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    {h : ℤ} {cell₁ cell₂ : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hbox₁ : cell₁ ∈ offsetBox L)
    (hbox₂ : cell₂ ∈ offsetBox L)
    (h₁ : OnChannel a b h cell₁)
    (h₂ : OnChannel a b h cell₂)
    (hne : cell₁ ≠ cell₂) :
    a ≤ L ∧ b ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hfirst, hsecond⟩ :=
    channel_difference_eq_multiple ha hb hab h₁ h₂
  have ht : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro htzero
    apply hne
    apply Prod.ext
    · have : cell₁.1 - cell₂.1 = 0 := by simpa [htzero] using hfirst
      omega
    · have : cell₁.2 - cell₂.2 = 0 := by simpa [htzero] using hsecond
      omega
  have ht_abs : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |t| := (Int.one_le_abs ht)
  have ha_nonneg : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (a : ℤ) := by positivity
  have hb_nonneg : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (b : ℤ) := by positivity
  have hcoord₁ :
      |cell₁.1 - cell₂.1| ≤ (L : ℤ) :=
    abs_sub_le_of_mem_offsetInterval
      (by simpa [offsetBox] using (mem_product.mp hbox₁).1)
      (by simpa [offsetBox] using (mem_product.mp hbox₂).1)
  have hcoord₂ :
      |cell₁.2 - cell₂.2| ≤ (L : ℤ) :=
    abs_sub_le_of_mem_offsetInterval
      (by simpa [offsetBox] using (mem_product.mp hbox₁).2)
      (by simpa [offsetBox] using (mem_product.mp hbox₂).2)
  have hb_le : (b : ℤ) ≤ (L : ℤ) := by
    calc
      (b : ℤ) = (b : ℤ) * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ (b : ℤ) * |t| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht_abs hb_nonneg
      _ = |(b : ℤ) * t| := by simp [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hb_nonneg]
      _ = |cell₁.1 - cell₂.1| := by rw [hfirst]
      _ ≤ (L : ℤ) := hcoord₁
  have ha_le : (a : ℤ) ≤ (L : ℤ) := by
    calc
      (a : ℤ) = (a : ℤ) * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ (a : ℤ) * |t| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht_abs ha_nonneg
      _ = |(a : ℤ) * t| := by simp [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha_nonneg]
      _ = |cell₁.2 - cell₂.2| := by rw [hsecond]
      _ ≤ (L : ℤ) := hcoord₂
  exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast ha_le, by exact_mod_cast hb_le⟩

name: PaperC.channel_coefficients_le_length_of_mem
statement:
theorem channel_coefficients_le_length_of_mem
    {L a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    {h : ℤ} {cell₁ cell₂ : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hmem₁ : cell₁ ∈ channelCells L a b h)
    (hmem₂ : cell₂ ∈ channelCells L a b h)
    (hne : cell₁ ≠ cell₂) :
    a ≤ L ∧ b ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_channelCells] at hmem₁ hmem₂
  exact channel_coefficients_le_length ha hb hab
    hmem₁.1 hmem₂.1 hmem₁.2 hmem₂.2 hne

name: PaperC.CRT.solutions_modEq
statement:
theorem solutions_modEq
    (residue modulus : ι → ℕ) (indices : List ι)
    (hcoprime : indices.Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on modulus))
    {x y : ℕ}
    (hx : ∀ i ∈ indices, x ≡ residue i [MOD modulus i])
    (hy : ∀ i ∈ indices, y ≡ residue i [MOD modulus i]) :
    x ≡ y [MOD (indices.map modulus).prod]
proof:
:= by
  have hxrep :=
    Nat.chineseRemainderOfList_modEq_unique
      residue modulus indices hcoprime hx
  have hyrep :=
    Nat.chineseRemainderOfList_modEq_unique
      residue modulus indices hcoprime hy
  exact hxrep.trans hyrep.symm

name: PaperC.CRT.satisfies_iff_modEq_representative
statement:
theorem satisfies_iff_modEq_representative
    (residue modulus : ι → ℕ) (indices : List ι)
    (hcoprime : indices.Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on modulus))
    (x : ℕ) :
    (∀ i ∈ indices, x ≡ residue i [MOD modulus i]) ↔
      x ≡
        Nat.chineseRemainderOfList residue modulus indices hcoprime
          [MOD (indices.map modulus).prod]
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact Nat.chineseRemainderOfList_modEq_unique
      residue modulus indices hcoprime
  · intro hx i hi
    have hall :
        ∀ j ∈ indices,
          x ≡
            (Nat.chineseRemainderOfList
              residue modulus indices hcoprime : ℕ)
              [MOD modulus j] :=
      (Nat.modEq_list_map_prod_iff hcoprime).mp hx
    exact (hall i hi).trans
      ((Nat.chineseRemainderOfList
        residue modulus indices hcoprime).property i hi)

name: PaperC.CRT.satisfies_iff_intModEq_representative
statement:
theorem satisfies_iff_intModEq_representative
    (residue modulus : ι → ℕ) (indices : List ι)
    (hcoprime : indices.Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on modulus))
    (x : ℕ) :
    (∀ i ∈ indices,
        (x : ℤ) ≡ (residue i : ℤ) [ZMOD (modulus i : ℤ)]) ↔
      (x : ℤ) ≡
        (Nat.chineseRemainderOfList
          residue modulus indices hcoprime : ℕ)
        [ZMOD ((indices.map modulus).prod : ℤ)]
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Int.natCast_modEq_iff] using
    satisfies_iff_modEq_representative
      residue modulus indices hcoprime x

name: PaperC.CRT.representative_lt_product
statement:
theorem representative_lt_product
    (residue modulus : ι → ℕ) (indices : List ι)
    (hcoprime : indices.Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on modulus))
    (hnonzero : ∀ i ∈ indices, modulus i ≠ 0) :
    (Nat.chineseRemainderOfList
        residue modulus indices hcoprime : ℕ) <
      (indices.map modulus).prod
proof:
:=
  Nat.chineseRemainderOfList_lt_prod
    residue modulus indices hcoprime hnonzero

name: PaperC.DefectParitySupport.parityVec_mul_sq
statement:
theorem parityVec_mul_sq
    {s a : ℕ} (hs : s ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    parityVec (s * a ^ 2) = parityVec s
proof:
:= by
  rw [parityVec_mul hs (pow_ne_zero 2 ha), parityVec_pow_two, add_zero]

name: PaperC.DefectParitySupport.dvd_of_parityVec_mul_sq_ne_zero
statement:
theorem dvd_of_parityVec_mul_sq_ne_zero
    {s a p : ℕ} (hs : s ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hp : parityVec (s * a ^ 2) p ≠ 0) :
    p ∣ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [parityVec_mul_sq hs ha, parityVec_apply] at hp
  apply Nat.dvd_of_factorization_pos
  intro hzero
  rw [hzero] at hp
  simp at hp

name: PaperC.DefectParitySupport.dvd_defectPart_of_eq_mul_sq_of_parityVec_ne_zero
statement:
theorem dvd_defectPart_of_eq_mul_sq_of_parityVec_ne_zero
    {n s a p : ℕ} (hs : s ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hn : n = s * a ^ 2)
    (hp : parityVec n p ≠ 0) :
    p ∣ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [hn] at hp
  exact dvd_of_parityVec_mul_sq_ne_zero hs ha hp

name: PaperC.DefectParitySupport.prime_of_parityVec_ne_zero
statement:
theorem prime_of_parityVec_ne_zero
    {n p : ℕ} (hp : parityVec n p ≠ 0) :
    Nat.Prime p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hprime
  simp only [parityVec_apply,
    Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime n hprime, Nat.cast_zero] at hp
  exact hp rfl

name: PaperC.DefectParitySupport.parityCoverage_of_eq_mul_sq
statement:
theorem parityCoverage_of_eq_mul_sq
    {r n s a : ℕ} (smallPrime : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hs : s ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hn : n = s * a ^ 2)
    (hsmall : ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ s →
      ∃ j : Fin r, smallPrime j = p) :
    ∀ p, parityVec n p ≠ 0 →
      ∃ j : Fin r, smallPrime j = p
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  exact hsmall p (prime_of_parityVec_ne_zero hp)
    (dvd_defectPart_of_eq_mul_sq_of_parityVec_ne_zero
      hs ha hn hp)

name: PaperC.residualVertexPrimeCells_card_eq_residualPrimeCells_card
statement:
theorem residualVertexPrimeCells_card_eq_residualPrimeCells_card
    (L a b p : ℕ) (h : ℤ) :
    (residualVertexPrimeCells L a b p h).card =
      (residualPrimeCells L a b p h).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fintype.card_coe, ← Fintype.card_coe]
  exact Fintype.card_congr
    (residualVertexPrimeCellEquiv L a b p h)

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.parityVec_mul_small_eq
statement:
theorem parityVec_mul_small_eq
    {B c t p : ℕ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (ht : 0 < t) (hcB : c < B)
    (_hp : p.Prime) (hpB : B < p) :
    parityVec (c * t) p = parityVec t p
proof:
:= by
  have hcp : c < p := hcB.trans hpB
  have hpNotDvd : ¬p ∣ c := by
    intro hpDvd
    exact (Nat.not_le_of_gt hcp)
      (Nat.le_of_dvd hc hpDvd)
  have hcParity : parityVec c p = 0 := by
    rw [parityVec_apply,
      Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd hpNotDvd]
    rfl
  have hmul :=
    congrArg (fun v : ℕ →₀ F₂ => v p)
      (parityVec_mul hc.ne' ht.ne')
  simpa only [Finsupp.add_apply, hcParity, zero_add] using hmul

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.exactUnit_large_parity_eq
statement:
theorem exactUnit_large_parity_eq
    {B a b t X Y p : ℕ}
    (h : ExactUnitFactorization B a b t X Y)
    (hp : p.Prime) (hpB : B < p) :
    parityVec X p = parityVec t p ∧
      parityVec t p = parityVec Y p
proof:
:= by
  have haB : a < B :=
    (Nat.le_max_left a b).trans_lt h.height_lt
  have hbB : b < B :=
    (Nat.le_max_right a b).trans_lt h.height_lt
  constructor
  · rw [h.left_eq]
    exact parityVec_mul_small_eq h.b_pos h.t_pos hbB hp hpB
  · rw [h.right_eq]
    exact
      (parityVec_mul_small_eq
        h.a_pos h.t_pos haB hp hpB).symm

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.exactUnit_large_factorization_odd_iff
statement:
theorem exactUnit_large_factorization_odd_iff
    {B a b t X Y p : ℕ}
    (h : ExactUnitFactorization B a b t X Y)
    (hp : p.Prime) (hpB : B < p) :
    (Odd (X.factorization p) ↔ Odd (t.factorization p)) ∧
      (Odd (t.factorization p) ↔ Odd (Y.factorization p))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hXt, htY⟩ :=
    exactUnit_large_parity_eq h hp hpB
  constructor
  · rw [← ZMod.natCast_ne_zero_iff_odd, ← ZMod.natCast_ne_zero_iff_odd]
    change parityVec X p ≠ 0 ↔ parityVec t p ≠ 0
    rw [hXt]
  · rw [← ZMod.natCast_ne_zero_iff_odd, ← ZMod.natCast_ne_zero_iff_odd]
    change parityVec t p ≠ 0 ↔ parityVec Y p ≠ 0
    rw [htY]

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.largeOddPrimeSupport_mul_small_eq
statement:
theorem largeOddPrimeSupport_mul_small_eq
    {B c t : ℕ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (ht : 0 < t) (hcB : c < B) :
    largeOddPrimeSupport B (c * t) =
      largeOddPrimeSupport B t
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · intro hpMem
    have hpData :=
      prime_and_large_of_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport hpMem
    have hpParity :=
      (mem_largeOddPrimeSupport_iff.mp hpMem).2
    rw [mem_largeOddPrimeSupport_iff]
    refine ⟨hpData.2, ?_⟩
    have heq :=
      parityVec_mul_small_eq hc ht hcB hpData.1 hpData.2
    simpa only [← heq] using hpParity
  · intro hpMem
    have hpData :=
      prime_and_large_of_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport hpMem
    have hpParity :=
      (mem_largeOddPrimeSupport_iff.mp hpMem).2
    rw [mem_largeOddPrimeSupport_iff]
    refine ⟨hpData.2, ?_⟩
    have heq :=
      parityVec_mul_small_eq hc ht hcB hpData.1 hpData.2
    simpa only [heq] using hpParity

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.largeOddKernel_mul_small_eq
statement:
theorem largeOddKernel_mul_small_eq
    {B c t : ℕ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (ht : 0 < t) (hcB : c < B) :
    largeOddKernel B (c * t) =
      largeOddKernel B t
proof:
:= by
  unfold largeOddKernel
  rw [largeOddPrimeSupport_mul_small_eq hc ht hcB]

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.exactUnit_largeOddPrimeSupport_eq
statement:
theorem exactUnit_largeOddPrimeSupport_eq
    {B a b t X Y : ℕ}
    (h : ExactUnitFactorization B a b t X Y) :
    largeOddPrimeSupport B X =
        largeOddPrimeSupport B t ∧
      largeOddPrimeSupport B Y =
        largeOddPrimeSupport B t
proof:
:= by
  have haB : a < B :=
    (Nat.le_max_left a b).trans_lt h.height_lt
  have hbB : b < B :=
    (Nat.le_max_right a b).trans_lt h.height_lt
  constructor
  · rw [h.left_eq]
    exact
      largeOddPrimeSupport_mul_small_eq
        h.b_pos h.t_pos hbB
  · rw [h.right_eq]
    exact
      largeOddPrimeSupport_mul_small_eq
        h.a_pos h.t_pos haB

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.exactUnit_largeOddKernel_eq
statement:
theorem exactUnit_largeOddKernel_eq
    {B a b t X Y : ℕ}
    (h : ExactUnitFactorization B a b t X Y) :
    largeOddKernel B X = largeOddKernel B t ∧
      largeOddKernel B Y = largeOddKernel B t
proof:
:= by
  have hs := exactUnit_largeOddPrimeSupport_eq h
  constructor <;> unfold largeOddKernel
  · rw [hs.1]
  · rw [hs.2]

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.common_largeOddKernel_dvd
statement:
theorem common_largeOddKernel_dvd
    {B a b t X Y : ℕ}
    (h : ExactUnitFactorization B a b t X Y) :
    largeOddKernel B t ∣ X ∧
      largeOddKernel B t ∣ t ∧
      largeOddKernel B t ∣ Y
proof:
:= by
  have hk := exactUnit_largeOddKernel_eq h
  refine ⟨?_, largeOddKernel_dvd B t, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hk.1]
    exact largeOddKernel_dvd B X
  · rw [← hk.2]
    exact largeOddKernel_dvd B Y

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.hDefective_left_iff
statement:
theorem hDefective_left_iff
    {B a b t X Y : ℕ}
    (h : ExactUnitFactorization B a b t X Y) :
    HDefective B X ↔ HDefective B t
proof:
:= by
  have hk := (exactUnit_largeOddKernel_eq h).1
  rw [← largeOddKernel_eq_one_iff_hDefective,
    ← largeOddKernel_eq_one_iff_hDefective, hk]

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.hDefective_right_iff
statement:
theorem hDefective_right_iff
    {B a b t X Y : ℕ}
    (h : ExactUnitFactorization B a b t X Y) :
    HDefective B Y ↔ HDefective B t
proof:
:= by
  have hk := (exactUnit_largeOddKernel_eq h).2
  rw [← largeOddKernel_eq_one_iff_hDefective,
    ← largeOddKernel_eq_one_iff_hDefective, hk]

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.exactUnit_defect_dichotomy
statement:
theorem exactUnit_defect_dichotomy
    {B a b t X Y : ℕ}
    (h : ExactUnitFactorization B a b t X Y) :
    (largeOddKernel B t = 1 ∧
        HDefective B X ∧ HDefective B t ∧ HDefective B Y) ∨
      (1 < largeOddKernel B t ∧
        ¬HDefective B X ∧ ¬HDefective B t ∧ ¬HDefective B Y)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : largeOddKernel B t = 1
  · left
    have htDef :
        HDefective B t :=
      (largeOddKernel_eq_one_iff_hDefective B t).mp hk
    exact
      ⟨hk, (hDefective_left_iff h).mpr htDef, htDef,
        (hDefective_right_iff h).mpr htDef⟩
  · right
    have hkgt : 1 < largeOddKernel B t := by
      have hkle := one_le_largeOddKernel B t
      omega
    have htNot : ¬HDefective B t := by
      intro htDef
      exact hk
        ((largeOddKernel_eq_one_iff_hDefective B t).mpr htDef)
    exact
      ⟨hkgt,
        fun hX ↦ htNot ((hDefective_left_iff h).mp hX),
        htNot,
        fun hY ↦ htNot ((hDefective_right_iff h).mp hY)⟩

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.exists_common_large_odd_prime
statement:
theorem exists_common_large_odd_prime
    {B a b t X Y : ℕ}
    (h : ExactUnitFactorization B a b t X Y)
    (hk : largeOddKernel B t ≠ 1) :
    ∃ p : ℕ,
      p.Prime ∧ B < p ∧
        parityVec X p ≠ 0 ∧ parityVec t p ≠ 0 ∧
        parityVec Y p ≠ 0 ∧
        p ∣ largeOddKernel B t ∧
        p ∣ X ∧ p ∣ t ∧ p ∣ Y
proof:
:= by
  have hsne :
      largeOddPrimeSupport B t ≠ ∅ := by
    intro hs
    exact hk
      ((largeOddKernel_eq_one_iff_support_eq_empty B t).mpr hs)
  obtain ⟨p, hpMem⟩ :=
    Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hsne
  have hpData :=
    prime_and_large_of_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport hpMem
  have hpt :=
    (mem_largeOddPrimeSupport_iff.mp hpMem).2
  have hparity :=
    exactUnit_large_parity_eq h hpData.1 hpData.2
  have hpKernel :
      p ∣ largeOddKernel B t :=
    (prime_dvd_largeOddKernel_iff hpData.1).mpr hpMem
  have hkDvd := common_largeOddKernel_dvd h
  exact
    ⟨p, hpData.1, hpData.2,
      by simpa only [hparity.1] using hpt,
      hpt,
      by simpa only [← hparity.2] using hpt,
      hpKernel,
      hpKernel.trans hkDvd.1,
      hpKernel.trans hkDvd.2.1,
      hpKernel.trans hkDvd.2.2⟩

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.prime_dvd_unique_in_block
statement:
theorem prime_dvd_unique_in_block
    {B p x i j : ℕ}
    (hpB : B < p) (hi : i < B) (hj : j < B)
    (hpi : p ∣ x + i) (hpj : p ∣ x + j) :
    i = j
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hij
  have hlabel : x + i ≠ x + j := by
    omega
  have hdist : Nat.dist (x + i) (x + j) < B := by
    rw [Nat.dist_add_add_left]
    simp only [Nat.dist]
    omega
  exact
    (PrivatePivots.not_dvd_of_dvd_and_dist_lt
      hpi hlabel hpB hdist) hpj

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.parityVec_ne_zero_unique_in_block
statement:
theorem parityVec_ne_zero_unique_in_block
    {B p x i j : ℕ}
    (hpB : B < p) (hi : i < B) (hj : j < B)
    (hip : parityVec (x + i) p ≠ 0)
    (hjp : parityVec (x + j) p ≠ 0) :
    i = j
proof:
:= by
  have hpi : p ∣ x + i := by
    by_contra hnot
    apply hip
    rw [parityVec_apply,
      Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd hnot]
    rfl
  have hpj : p ∣ x + j := by
    by_contra hnot
    apply hjp
    rw [parityVec_apply,
      Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd hnot]
    rfl
  exact prime_dvd_unique_in_block hpB hi hj hpi hpj

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.mem_smallPrimesUpTo
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_smallPrimesUpTo {H p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ smallPrimesUpTo H ↔ p.Prime ∧ p ≤ H
proof:
:= by
  simp [smallPrimesUpTo, Nat.lt_succ_iff, and_comm]

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.DefectRepresentation.value_eq_defectPart_mul_sq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem DefectRepresentation.value_eq_defectPart_mul_sq
    {P : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ} (rep : DefectRepresentation P n) :
    n = rep.defectPart * rep.squarePart ^ 2
proof:
:=
  rep.value_eq

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.mem_valuesForSupport_iff
statement:
theorem mem_valuesForSupport_iff
    {support : Finset ℕ} {X n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ valuesForSupport support X ↔
      n ≤ X ∧ ∃ a ≤ Nat.sqrt X, n = support.prod id * a ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [valuesForSupport, Nat.lt_succ_iff, eq_comm, and_comm,
    and_left_comm, and_assoc]

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.mem_defectValues_iff
statement:
theorem mem_defectValues_iff {P : Finset ℕ} {X n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ defectValues P X ↔
      n ≤ X ∧
        ∃ support ⊆ P, ∃ a ≤ Nat.sqrt X,
          n = support.prod id * a ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [defectValues, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_powerset,
    mem_valuesForSupport_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨support, hsP, hnX, a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hnX, support, hsP, a, ha, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hnX, support, hsP, a, ha, hvalue⟩
    exact ⟨support, hsP, hnX, a, ha, hvalue⟩

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.squarePart_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem squarePart_le_sqrt
    {P : Finset ℕ} {X n : ℕ}
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, 1 ≤ p)
    (rep : DefectRepresentation P n)
    (hnX : n ≤ X) :
    rep.squarePart ≤ Nat.sqrt X
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.le_sqrt']
  calc
    rep.squarePart ^ 2 = 1 * rep.squarePart ^ 2 := by simp
    _ ≤ rep.support.prod id * rep.squarePart ^ 2 := by
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
      apply Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
      rw [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
      intro p hp
      exact Nat.ne_of_gt
        (Nat.zero_lt_one.trans_le (hP p (rep.support_subset hp)))
    _ = n := rep.value_eq.symm
    _ ≤ X := hnX

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.mem_defectValues_of_representation
statement:
theorem mem_defectValues_of_representation
    {P : Finset ℕ} {X n : ℕ}
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, 1 ≤ p)
    (rep : DefectRepresentation P n)
    (hnX : n ≤ X) :
    n ∈ defectValues P X
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_defectValues_iff]
  exact ⟨hnX, rep.support, rep.support_subset, rep.squarePart,
    squarePart_le_sqrt hP rep hnX, rep.value_eq⟩

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.mem_defectValues_of_HDefectRepresentation
statement:
theorem mem_defectValues_of_HDefectRepresentation
    {H X n : ℕ}
    (rep : HDefectRepresentation H n)
    (hnX : n ≤ X) :
    n ∈ defectValues (smallPrimesUpTo H) X
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_defectValues_of_representation _ rep hnX
  intro p hp
  exact (mem_smallPrimesUpTo.mp hp).1.one_lt.le

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.card_valuesForSupport_le
statement:
theorem card_valuesForSupport_le (support : Finset ℕ) (X : ℕ) :
    (valuesForSupport support X).card ≤ Nat.sqrt X + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold valuesForSupport
  exact (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans
    (Finset.card_image_le.trans_eq (Finset.card_range _))

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.card_defectValues_le_sum
statement:
theorem card_defectValues_le_sum (P : Finset ℕ) (X : ℕ) :
    (defectValues P X).card ≤
      ∑ support ∈ P.powerset, (valuesForSupport support X).card
proof:
:= by
  unfold defectValues
  exact Finset.card_biUnion_le

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.card_defectValues_le
statement:
theorem card_defectValues_le (P : Finset ℕ) (X : ℕ) :
    (defectValues P X).card ≤
      (Nat.sqrt X + 1) * 2 ^ P.card
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (defectValues P X).card
        ≤ ∑ support ∈ P.powerset,
            (valuesForSupport support X).card :=
      card_defectValues_le_sum P X
    _ ≤ ∑ _support ∈ P.powerset, (Nat.sqrt X + 1) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun support _ ↦
        card_valuesForSupport_le support X
    _ = (Nat.sqrt X + 1) * 2 ^ P.card := by
      simp [Finset.card_powerset, Nat.mul_comm]

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.card_HDefectValues_le
statement:
theorem card_HDefectValues_le (H X : ℕ) :
    (defectValues (smallPrimesUpTo H) X).card ≤
      (Nat.sqrt X + 1) * 2 ^ (smallPrimesUpTo H).card
proof:
:=
  card_defectValues_le _ _

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.intervalStartsContaining_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem intervalStartsContaining_subset_Icc
    (starts : Finset ℕ) (H n : ℕ) :
    intervalStartsContaining starts H n ⊆ Finset.Icc (n - H) n
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  rw [intervalStartsContaining, Finset.mem_filter] at hu
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
  exact ⟨by
    rw [Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add]
    simpa [Nat.add_comm] using hu.2.2, hu.2.1⟩

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.card_intervalStartsContaining_le
statement:
theorem card_intervalStartsContaining_le
    (starts : Finset ℕ) (H n : ℕ) :
    (intervalStartsContaining starts H n).card ≤ H + 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (intervalStartsContaining starts H n).card
        ≤ (Finset.Icc (n - H) n).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card
        (intervalStartsContaining_subset_Icc starts H n)
    _ = n + 1 - (n - H) := Nat.card_Icc (n - H) n
    _ ≤ H + 1 := by omega

name: PaperC.mem_reducedChannelCandidates
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_reducedChannelCandidates
    {x y B H a b : ℕ} :
    (a, b) ∈ reducedChannelCandidates x y B H ↔
      0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ a ≤ H ∧ b ≤ H ∧
        a.Coprime b ∧
        SatisfiesChannelInequality x y B a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [reducedChannelCandidates, Nat.succ_le_iff,
    and_assoc, and_left_comm, and_comm]

name: PaperC.card_reducedChannelCandidates_le_one
statement:
theorem card_reducedChannelCandidates_le_one
    {x y B H : ℕ} (hx : 4 * H ^ 2 * B < x) :
    (reducedChannelCandidates x y B H).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.card_le_one]
  intro c hc d hd
  obtain ⟨ha, hb, haH, hbH, hab, hclose⟩ :=
    mem_reducedChannelCandidates.mp hc
  obtain ⟨ha', hb', ha'H, hb'H, hab', hclose'⟩ :=
    mem_reducedChannelCandidates.mp hd
  obtain ⟨hfst, hsnd⟩ :=
    reducedChannel_unique x y B H
      c.1 c.2 d.1 d.2
      ha hb ha' hb' hab hab'
      haH hbH ha'H hb'H hx hclose hclose'
  exact Prod.ext hfst hsnd

name: PaperC.canonicalReducedChannel?_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem canonicalReducedChannel?_eq_none_iff
    {x y B H : ℕ} :
    canonicalReducedChannel? x y B H = none ↔
      reducedChannelCandidates x y B H = ∅
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [canonicalReducedChannel?, Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty]

name: PaperC.canonicalReducedChannel?_mem
statement:
theorem canonicalReducedChannel?_mem
    {x y B H : ℕ} {c : ℕ × ℕ}
    (hc : canonicalReducedChannel? x y B H = some c) :
    c ∈ reducedChannelCandidates x y B H
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold canonicalReducedChannel? at hc
  split at hc
  · simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hc
    subst c
    exact ‹(reducedChannelCandidates x y B H).Nonempty›.choose_spec
  · simp at hc

name: PaperC.canonicalReducedChannel?_eq_some_of_mem
statement:
theorem canonicalReducedChannel?_eq_some_of_mem
    {x y B H : ℕ} (hx : 4 * H ^ 2 * B < x)
    {c : ℕ × ℕ}
    (hc : c ∈ reducedChannelCandidates x y B H) :
    canonicalReducedChannel? x y B H = some c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s := reducedChannelCandidates x y B H
  have hnonempty : s.Nonempty := ⟨c, hc⟩
  unfold canonicalReducedChannel?
  rw [dif_pos hnonempty]
  congr 1
  have hcard :=
    card_reducedChannelCandidates_le_one
      (x := x) (y := y) (B := B) (H := H) hx
  rw [Finset.card_le_one] at hcard
  exact hcard _ hnonempty.choose_spec _ hc

name: PaperC.abs_lt_length_add_one_of_mem_offsetInterval
statement:
theorem abs_lt_length_add_one_of_mem_offsetInterval
    {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) {i : ℤ}
    (hi : i ∈ offsetInterval L) :
    |i| < (L + 1 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_offsetInterval] at hi
  rw [abs_lt]
  constructor <;> omega

name: PaperC.abs_channelParameter_lt
statement:
theorem abs_channelParameter_lt
    {L a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    {h : ℤ} {cell : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hcell : cell ∈ channelCells L a b h) :
    |h| < (((a + b) * (L + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hdata := mem_channelCells.mp hcell
  by_cases hL : L = 0
  · subst L
    have hi : cell.1 = -1 := by
      have hiBounds := (mem_offsetBox.mp hdata.1).1
      norm_num at hiBounds
      omega
    have hj : cell.2 = -1 := by
      have hjBounds := (mem_offsetBox.mp hdata.1).2
      norm_num at hjBounds
      omega
    have hchannel := hdata.2
    unfold OnChannel at hchannel
    rw [hi, hj] at hchannel
    rw [← hchannel]
    push_cast
    rw [abs_lt]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hLpos : 0 < L := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hL
  have hi :
      |cell.1| < ((L + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast
      abs_lt_length_add_one_of_mem_offsetInterval hLpos
        (by simpa [offsetBox] using
          (Finset.mem_product.mp hdata.1).1)
  have hj :
      |cell.2| < ((L + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast
      abs_lt_length_add_one_of_mem_offsetInterval hLpos
        (by simpa [offsetBox] using
          (Finset.mem_product.mp hdata.1).2)
  have haZ : (0 : ℤ) < (a : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast ha
  have hbZ : (0 : ℤ) < (b : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have htriangle :
      |(a : ℤ) * cell.1 - (b : ℤ) * cell.2| ≤
        (a : ℤ) * |cell.1| + (b : ℤ) * |cell.2| := by
    calc
      |(a : ℤ) * cell.1 - (b : ℤ) * cell.2| ≤
          |(a : ℤ) * cell.1| + |(b : ℤ) * cell.2| :=
        abs_sub _ _
      _ = (a : ℤ) * |cell.1| + (b : ℤ) * |cell.2| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos haZ, abs_of_pos hbZ]
  rw [← hdata.2]
  calc
    |(a : ℤ) * cell.1 - (b : ℤ) * cell.2| ≤
        (a : ℤ) * |cell.1| + (b : ℤ) * |cell.2| :=
      htriangle
    _ < (a : ℤ) * (L + 1 : ℕ) +
          (b : ℤ) * (L + 1 : ℕ) :=
      add_lt_add
        (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hi haZ)
        (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hj hbZ)
    _ = (((a + b) * (L + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      push_cast
      ring

name: PaperC.pairChannelError_eq_of_exact_unit
statement:
theorem pairChannelError_eq_of_exact_unit
    {x y a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ} {cell : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hchannel : OnChannel a b h cell)
    (hexact :
      (a : ℤ) * ((x : ℤ) + cell.1) =
        (b : ℤ) * ((y : ℤ) + cell.2)) :
    pairChannelError x y a b = h
proof:
:= by
  unfold pairChannelError OnChannel at *
  linarith

name: PaperC.channel_mem_reducedCandidates_of_two_units
statement:
theorem channel_mem_reducedCandidates_of_two_units
    {x y L A a b : ℕ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    {h : ℤ}
    (hparameter : pairChannelError x y a b = h)
    (hm : 2 ≤ (channelCells L a b h).card) :
    (a, b) ∈
      reducedChannelCandidates x y (L + 1) ((L + 1) ^ A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨cell₁, hcell₁, cell₂, hcell₂, hne⟩ :
      ∃ cell₁ ∈ channelCells L a b h,
        ∃ cell₂ ∈ channelCells L a b h, cell₁ ≠ cell₂ := by
    exact Finset.one_lt_card.mp hm
  have hheight :=
    channel_coefficients_le_length_of_mem
      ha hb hab hcell₁ hcell₂ hne
  have hbase : L + 1 ≤ (L + 1) ^ A := by
    calc
      L + 1 = (L + 1) ^ 1 := (pow_one _).symm
      _ ≤ (L + 1) ^ A :=
        pow_le_pow_right' (by omega) hA
  rw [mem_reducedChannelCandidates]
  refine ⟨ha, hb, hheight.1.trans (Nat.le_succ L) |>.trans hbase,
    hheight.2.trans (Nat.le_succ L) |>.trans hbase, hab, ?_⟩
  unfold SatisfiesChannelInequality
  rw [hparameter]
  exact abs_channelParameter_lt ha hb hcell₁

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.mem_primesBetween
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_primesBetween {B X p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ primesBetween B X ↔ p.Prime ∧ B < p ∧ p ≤ X
proof:
:= by
  simp only [primesBetween, Finset.mem_filter,
    DefectCounting.mem_smallPrimesUpTo]
  aesop

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.primesBetween_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem primesBetween_self (B : ℕ) :
    primesBetween B B = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.mem_dyadicPrimes
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_dyadicPrimes {B K p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ dyadicPrimes B K ↔
      p.Prime ∧ B < p ∧ p ≤ B * 2 ^ K
proof:
:= by
  simp [dyadicPrimes]

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.two_le_log_two
statement:
private theorem two_le_log_two {B : ℕ} (hB : 4 ≤ B) :
    2 ≤ Nat.log 2 B
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by norm_num)
  norm_num
  exact hB

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.primesBetween_subset_smallPrimesUpTo
statement:
private theorem primesBetween_subset_smallPrimesUpTo (B X : ℕ) :
    primesBetween B X ⊆ DefectCounting.smallPrimesUpTo X
proof:
:=
  Finset.filter_subset _ _

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.card_primesBetween_le_count
statement:
private theorem card_primesBetween_le_count (B X : ℕ) :
    (primesBetween B X).card ≤ PrimesUpTo.count X
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (primesBetween B X).card ≤
        (DefectCounting.smallPrimesUpTo X).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card (primesBetween_subset_smallPrimesUpTo B X)
    _ = PrimesUpTo.count X :=
      (PrimeCountBridge.count_eq_card_smallPrimesUpTo X).symm

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.log_mul_card_shell_le
statement:
private theorem log_mul_card_shell_le
    {B Y : ℕ} (hB : 4 ≤ B) (hBY : B ≤ Y) :
    Nat.log 2 B * (primesBetween Y (2 * Y)).card ≤ 14 * Y
proof:
:= by
  have hlog :
      Nat.log 2 B ≤ Nat.log 2 (2 * Y) :=
    Nat.log_mono_right (hBY.trans (by omega))
  have hcard :
      (primesBetween Y (2 * Y)).card ≤
        PrimesUpTo.count (2 * Y) :=
    card_primesBetween_le_count Y (2 * Y)
  calc
    Nat.log 2 B * (primesBetween Y (2 * Y)).card
        ≤ Nat.log 2 (2 * Y) * PrimesUpTo.count (2 * Y) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul hlog hcard
    _ ≤ 7 * (2 * Y) :=
      ChebyshevPrimeCount.log_mul_count_le_seven_mul
        (H := 2 * Y) (by omega)
    _ = 14 * Y := by omega

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_shell_le
statement:
private theorem sum_inv_shell_le
    {B Y : ℕ} (hB : 4 ≤ B) (hBY : B ≤ Y) :
    (∑ p ∈ primesBetween Y (2 * Y), 1 / (p : ℚ)) ≤
      14 / (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hYpos : (0 : ℚ) < (Y : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < Y by omega)
  have hlogPos : (0 : ℚ) < (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < Nat.log 2 B by
      have := two_le_log_two hB
      omega)
  have hterm :
      ∀ p ∈ primesBetween Y (2 * Y),
        1 / (p : ℚ) ≤ 1 / (Y : ℚ) := by
    intro p hp
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le hYpos
    exact_mod_cast (mem_primesBetween.mp hp).2.1.le
  have hsum :
      (∑ p ∈ primesBetween Y (2 * Y), 1 / (p : ℚ)) ≤
        ((primesBetween Y (2 * Y)).card : ℚ) / (Y : ℚ) := by
    calc
      (∑ p ∈ primesBetween Y (2 * Y), 1 / (p : ℚ))
          ≤ ∑ _p ∈ primesBetween Y (2 * Y), 1 / (Y : ℚ) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
      _ = ((primesBetween Y (2 * Y)).card : ℚ) /
          (Y : ℚ) := by
        simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hcardQ :
      (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ) *
          ((primesBetween Y (2 * Y)).card : ℚ) ≤
        14 * (Y : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast log_mul_card_shell_le hB hBY
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ primesBetween Y (2 * Y), 1 / (p : ℚ))
        ≤ ((primesBetween Y (2 * Y)).card : ℚ) / (Y : ℚ) :=
      hsum
    _ ≤ 14 / (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ) := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hYpos hlogPos]
      simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hcardQ

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_sq_shell_le
statement:
private theorem sum_inv_sq_shell_le
    {B Y : ℕ} (hB : 4 ≤ B) (hBY : B ≤ Y) :
    (∑ p ∈ primesBetween Y (2 * Y), 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2) ≤
      14 / ((Y : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  have hYpos : (0 : ℚ) < (Y : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < Y by omega)
  have hlogPos : (0 : ℚ) < (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < Nat.log 2 B by
      have := two_le_log_two hB
      omega)
  have hterm :
      ∀ p ∈ primesBetween Y (2 * Y),
        1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / (Y : ℚ) ^ 2 := by
    intro p hp
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (sq_pos_of_pos hYpos)
    have hpY : (Y : ℚ) ≤ (p : ℚ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (mem_primesBetween.mp hp).2.1.le
    nlinarith
  have hsum :
      (∑ p ∈ primesBetween Y (2 * Y), 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2) ≤
        ((primesBetween Y (2 * Y)).card : ℚ) /
          (Y : ℚ) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      (∑ p ∈ primesBetween Y (2 * Y), 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2)
          ≤ ∑ _p ∈ primesBetween Y (2 * Y),
              1 / (Y : ℚ) ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
      _ = ((primesBetween Y (2 * Y)).card : ℚ) /
          (Y : ℚ) ^ 2 := by
        simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hcardQ :
      (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ) *
          ((primesBetween Y (2 * Y)).card : ℚ) ≤
        14 * (Y : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast log_mul_card_shell_le hB hBY
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ primesBetween Y (2 * Y), 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2)
        ≤ ((primesBetween Y (2 * Y)).card : ℚ) /
          (Y : ℚ) ^ 2 :=
      hsum
    _ ≤ 14 / ((Y : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ)) := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hYpos)
        (mul_pos hYpos hlogPos)]
      calc
        ((primesBetween Y (2 * Y)).card : ℚ) *
            ((Y : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ)) =
            (Y : ℚ) *
              ((Nat.log 2 B : ℚ) *
                ((primesBetween Y (2 * Y)).card : ℚ)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (Y : ℚ) * (14 * (Y : ℚ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcardQ hYpos.le
        _ = 14 * (Y : ℚ) ^ 2 := by ring

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.primesBetween_double_eq_union
statement:
private theorem primesBetween_double_eq_union
    {B Y : ℕ} (hBY : B ≤ Y) :
    primesBetween B (2 * Y) =
      primesBetween B Y ∪ primesBetween Y (2 * Y)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [mem_primesBetween, Finset.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, hBp, hp2Y⟩
    by_cases hpY : p ≤ Y
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hp, hBp, hpY⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hp, lt_of_not_ge hpY, hp2Y⟩
  · rintro (hp | hp)
    · exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, hp.2.2.trans (by omega)⟩
    · exact ⟨hp.1, hBY.trans_lt hp.2.1, hp.2.2⟩

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.disjoint_primesBetween_adjacent
statement:
private theorem disjoint_primesBetween_adjacent (B Y : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (primesBetween B Y) (primesBetween Y (2 * Y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro p hp₁ hp₂
  have hpY := (mem_primesBetween.mp hp₁).2.2
  have hYp := (mem_primesBetween.mp hp₂).2.1
  omega

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.dyadicPrimes_succ_eq_union
statement:
private theorem dyadicPrimes_succ_eq_union (B K : ℕ) :
    dyadicPrimes B (K + 1) =
      dyadicPrimes B K ∪
        primesBetween (B * 2 ^ K) (2 * (B * 2 ^ K))
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : B ≤ B * 2 ^ K :=
    Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right B (by positivity)
  unfold dyadicPrimes
  rw [show B * 2 ^ (K + 1) = 2 * (B * 2 ^ K) by
    rw [pow_succ]
    ring]
  exact primesBetween_double_eq_union hscale

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.disjoint_dyadicPrimes_shell
proof:
:= by
  unfold dyadicPrimes
  exact disjoint_primesBetween_adjacent B (B * 2 ^ K)

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_dyadicPrimes_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_dyadicPrimes_le
    (B K : ℕ) (hB : 4 ≤ B) :
    (∑ p ∈ dyadicPrimes B K, 1 / (p : ℚ)) ≤
      14 * (K : ℚ) / (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  induction K with
  | zero =>
      simp [dyadicPrimes]
  | succ K ih =>
      have hscale : B ≤ B * 2 ^ K :=
        Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right B (by positivity)
      rw [show K + 1 = Nat.succ K by omega,
        dyadicPrimes_succ_eq_union,
        Finset.sum_union (disjoint_dyadicPrimes_shell B K)]
      have hshell :=
        sum_inv_shell_le hB hscale
      calc
        (∑ p ∈ dyadicPrimes B K, 1 / (p : ℚ)) +
              ∑ p ∈ primesBetween (B * 2 ^ K)
                (2 * (B * 2 ^ K)), 1 / (p : ℚ)
            ≤ 14 * (K : ℚ) / (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ) +
                14 / (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ) :=
          add_le_add ih hshell
        _ = 14 * (Nat.succ K : ℚ) /
            (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ) := by
          push_cast
          ring

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_two_pow_le_two
statement:
private theorem sum_inv_two_pow_le_two (K : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, 1 / ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hgeom :
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, (1 / 2 : ℚ) ^ k) =
        (((1 / 2 : ℚ) ^ K - 1) / ((1 / 2 : ℚ) - 1)) :=
    geom_sum_eq (by norm_num) K
  have hpowNonneg : (0 : ℚ) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℚ) ^ K := by positivity
  calc
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, 1 / ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℚ)) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, (1 / 2 : ℚ) ^ k := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      push_cast
      rw [one_div_pow]
    _ = (((1 / 2 : ℚ) ^ K - 1) /
        ((1 / 2 : ℚ) - 1)) := hgeom
    _ ≤ 2 := by
      norm_num
      linarith

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_sq_dyadicPrimes_le_geometric
statement:
private theorem sum_inv_sq_dyadicPrimes_le_geometric
    (B K : ℕ) (hB : 4 ≤ B) :
    (∑ p ∈ dyadicPrimes B K, 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2) ≤
      (14 / ((B : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ))) *
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, 1 / ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  induction K with
  | zero =>
      simp [dyadicPrimes]
  | succ K ih =>
      have hscale : B ≤ B * 2 ^ K :=
        Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right B (by positivity)
      have hBpos : (0 : ℚ) < (B : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (show 0 < B by omega)
      have hlogPos : (0 : ℚ) < (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (show 0 < Nat.log 2 B by
          have := two_le_log_two hB
          omega)
      rw [show K + 1 = Nat.succ K by omega,
        dyadicPrimes_succ_eq_union,
        Finset.sum_union (disjoint_dyadicPrimes_shell B K),
        Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have hshell :=
        sum_inv_sq_shell_le hB hscale
      calc
        (∑ p ∈ dyadicPrimes B K, 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2) +
              ∑ p ∈ primesBetween (B * 2 ^ K)
                (2 * (B * 2 ^ K)), 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2
            ≤ (14 / ((B : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ))) *
                  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
                    1 / ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℚ) +
                14 /
                  (((B * 2 ^ K : ℕ) : ℚ) *
                    (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ)) :=
          add_le_add ih hshell
        _ = (14 / ((B : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ))) *
            (∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
                1 / ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℚ) +
              1 / ((2 ^ K : ℕ) : ℚ)) := by
          push_cast
          field_simp

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_sq_dyadicPrimes_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_sq_dyadicPrimes_le
    (B K : ℕ) (hB : 4 ≤ B) :
    (∑ p ∈ dyadicPrimes B K, 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2) ≤
      28 / ((B : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  have hBpos : (0 : ℚ) < (B : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < B by omega)
  have hlogPos : (0 : ℚ) < (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < Nat.log 2 B by
      have := two_le_log_two hB
      omega)
  have hfactorNonneg :
      0 ≤ 14 / ((B : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ)) := by positivity
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ dyadicPrimes B K, 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2) ≤
        (14 / ((B : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ))) *
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, 1 / ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℚ) :=
      sum_inv_sq_dyadicPrimes_le_geometric B K hB
    _ ≤ (14 / ((B : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ))) * 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_inv_two_pow_le_two K) hfactorNonneg
    _ = 28 / ((B : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ)) := by ring

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_subset_dyadicPrimes_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_subset_dyadicPrimes_le
    (B K : ℕ) (P : Finset ℕ) (hB : 4 ≤ B)
    (hP : P ⊆ dyadicPrimes B K) :
    (∑ p ∈ P, 1 / (p : ℚ)) ≤
      14 * (K : ℚ) / (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ P, 1 / (p : ℚ)) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ dyadicPrimes B K, 1 / (p : ℚ) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hP
        (fun p _hp _hpP ↦ by positivity)
    _ ≤ 14 * (K : ℚ) / (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ) :=
      sum_inv_dyadicPrimes_le B K hB

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_sq_subset_dyadicPrimes_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_sq_subset_dyadicPrimes_le
    (B K : ℕ) (P : Finset ℕ) (hB : 4 ≤ B)
    (hP : P ⊆ dyadicPrimes B K) :
    (∑ p ∈ P, 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2) ≤
      28 / ((B : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ P, 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ dyadicPrimes B K, 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hP
        (fun p _hp _hpP ↦ by positivity)
    _ ≤ 28 / ((B : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ)) :=
      sum_inv_sq_dyadicPrimes_le B K hB

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.four_mul_q_mul_B_le_dyadicCutoff
statement:
theorem four_mul_q_mul_B_le_dyadicCutoff (B q : ℕ) :
    4 * q * B ≤ B * 2 ^ (q + 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : q ≤ 2 ^ q :=
    (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := q)).le
  have hfour : 4 * q ≤ 4 * 2 ^ q :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 hq
  have hmul : B * (4 * q) ≤ B * (4 * 2 ^ q) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left B hfour
  simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hmul

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.mem_dyadicPrimes_add_two_of_prime_lt_four_mul
statement:
theorem mem_dyadicPrimes_add_two_of_prime_lt_four_mul
    {B q p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hBp : B < p)
    (hpUpper : p < 4 * q * B) :
    p ∈ dyadicPrimes B (q + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_dyadicPrimes]
  exact ⟨hp, hBp,
    hpUpper.le.trans (four_mul_q_mul_B_le_dyadicCutoff B q)⟩

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.subset_dyadicPrimes_add_two_of_prime_lt_four_mul
statement:
theorem subset_dyadicPrimes_add_two_of_prime_lt_four_mul
    {B q : ℕ} (P : Finset ℕ)
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime)
    (hlower : ∀ p ∈ P, B < p)
    (hupper : ∀ p ∈ P, p < 4 * q * B) :
    P ⊆ dyadicPrimes B (q + 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  exact mem_dyadicPrimes_add_two_of_prime_lt_four_mul
    (hprime p hp) (hlower p hp) (hupper p hp)

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_primes_lt_four_mul_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_primes_lt_four_mul_le
    {B q : ℕ} (P : Finset ℕ) (hB : 4 ≤ B)
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime)
    (hlower : ∀ p ∈ P, B < p)
    (hupper : ∀ p ∈ P, p < 4 * q * B) :
    (∑ p ∈ P, 1 / (p : ℚ)) ≤
      14 * ((q + 2 : ℕ) : ℚ) /
        (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  exact sum_inv_subset_dyadicPrimes_le B (q + 2) P hB
    (subset_dyadicPrimes_add_two_of_prime_lt_four_mul
      P hprime hlower hupper)

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_sq_primes_lt_four_mul_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_sq_primes_lt_four_mul_le
    {B q : ℕ} (P : Finset ℕ) (hB : 4 ≤ B)
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime)
    (hlower : ∀ p ∈ P, B < p)
    (hupper : ∀ p ∈ P, p < 4 * q * B) :
    (∑ p ∈ P, 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2) ≤
      28 / ((B : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  exact sum_inv_sq_subset_dyadicPrimes_le B (q + 2) P hB
    (subset_dyadicPrimes_add_two_of_prime_lt_four_mul
      P hprime hlower hupper)

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.mem_largeOddPrimeSupport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_largeOddPrimeSupport {B n p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ largeOddPrimeSupport B n ↔
      p ∈ oddPrimeSupport n ∧ B < p
proof:
:= by
  simp [largeOddPrimeSupport]

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.mem_smallOddPrimeSupport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_smallOddPrimeSupport {B n p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ smallOddPrimeSupport B n ↔
      p ∈ oddPrimeSupport n ∧ p ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  simp [smallOddPrimeSupport]

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.mem_oddPrimeSupport_iff_parityVec_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mem_oddPrimeSupport_iff_parityVec_ne_zero {n p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ oddPrimeSupport n ↔ parityVec n p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [oddPrimeSupport, oddFactorization, parityVec,
    Finsupp.mem_support_iff, Finsupp.mapRange_apply, ne_eq,
    ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h hp
    exact h (Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hp)
  · intro h hp
    exact h (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hp)

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.mem_largeOddPrimeSupport_iff
statement:
theorem mem_largeOddPrimeSupport_iff {B n p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ largeOddPrimeSupport B n ↔
      B < p ∧ parityVec n p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_largeOddPrimeSupport, mem_oddPrimeSupport_iff_parityVec_ne_zero]
  exact and_comm

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.mem_smallOddPrimeSupport_iff
statement:
theorem mem_smallOddPrimeSupport_iff {B n p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ smallOddPrimeSupport B n ↔
      p ≤ B ∧ parityVec n p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_smallOddPrimeSupport, mem_oddPrimeSupport_iff_parityVec_ne_zero]
  exact and_comm

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.prime_of_mem_oddPrimeSupport
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors
  exact Finsupp.support_mapRange hp

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.prime_and_large_of_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨prime_of_mem_oddPrimeSupport (mem_largeOddPrimeSupport.mp hp).1,
    (mem_largeOddPrimeSupport.mp hp).2⟩

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.prime_and_small_of_mem_smallOddPrimeSupport
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨prime_of_mem_oddPrimeSupport (mem_smallOddPrimeSupport.mp hp).1,
    (mem_smallOddPrimeSupport.mp hp).2⟩

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.parityVec_ne_zero_iff_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport
statement:
theorem parityVec_ne_zero_iff_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport
    {B n p : ℕ} (_hp : p.Prime) (hpB : B < p) :
    parityVec n p ≠ 0 ↔ p ∈ largeOddPrimeSupport B n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_largeOddPrimeSupport_iff]
  simp [hpB]

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.mem_largeOddPrimeSupport_iff_prime_large_odd
statement:
theorem mem_largeOddPrimeSupport_iff_prime_large_odd {B n p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ largeOddPrimeSupport B n ↔
      p.Prime ∧ B < p ∧ Odd (n.factorization p)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    exact ⟨(prime_and_large_of_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport hp).1,
      (prime_and_large_of_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport hp).2,
      ZMod.natCast_ne_zero_iff_odd.mp (by
        simpa only [parityVec_apply] using
          (mem_largeOddPrimeSupport_iff.mp hp).2)⟩
  · rintro ⟨_hpPrime, hpB, hpOdd⟩
    rw [mem_largeOddPrimeSupport_iff, parityVec_apply]
    exact ⟨hpB, ZMod.natCast_ne_zero_iff_odd.mpr hpOdd⟩

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.mem_smallOddPrimeSupport_iff_prime_small_odd
statement:
theorem mem_smallOddPrimeSupport_iff_prime_small_odd {B n p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ smallOddPrimeSupport B n ↔
      p.Prime ∧ p ≤ B ∧ Odd (n.factorization p)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    exact ⟨(prime_and_small_of_mem_smallOddPrimeSupport hp).1,
      (prime_and_small_of_mem_smallOddPrimeSupport hp).2,
      ZMod.natCast_ne_zero_iff_odd.mp (by
        simpa only [parityVec_apply] using
          (mem_smallOddPrimeSupport_iff.mp hp).2)⟩
  · rintro ⟨_hpPrime, hpB, hpOdd⟩
    rw [mem_smallOddPrimeSupport_iff, parityVec_apply]
    exact ⟨hpB, ZMod.natCast_ne_zero_iff_odd.mpr hpOdd⟩

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.largeOddPrimeSupport_subset_primeFactors
statement:
theorem largeOddPrimeSupport_subset_primeFactors (B n : ℕ) :
    largeOddPrimeSupport B n ⊆ n.primeFactors
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  exact Finsupp.support_mapRange (mem_largeOddPrimeSupport.mp hp).1

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.smallOddPrimeSupport_subset_primeFactors
statement:
theorem smallOddPrimeSupport_subset_primeFactors (B n : ℕ) :
    smallOddPrimeSupport B n ⊆ n.primeFactors
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  exact Finsupp.support_mapRange (mem_smallOddPrimeSupport.mp hp).1

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.largeOddKernel_ne_zero
statement:
theorem largeOddKernel_ne_zero (B n : ℕ) :
    largeOddKernel B n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [largeOddKernel, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
  intro p hp
  exact (prime_and_large_of_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport hp).1.ne_zero

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.smallOddPart_ne_zero
statement:
theorem smallOddPart_ne_zero (B n : ℕ) :
    smallOddPart B n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [smallOddPart, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
  intro p hp
  exact (prime_and_small_of_mem_smallOddPrimeSupport hp).1.ne_zero

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.primeFinset_product_injective
statement:
theorem primeFinset_product_injective
    {s t : Finset ℕ}
    (hs : ∀ p ∈ s, p.Prime)
    (ht : ∀ p ∈ t, p.Prime)
    (hprod : s.prod id = t.prod id) :
    s = t
proof:
:= by
  calc
    s = (s.prod id).primeFactors := (Nat.primeFactors_prod hs).symm
    _ = (t.prod id).primeFactors := congrArg Nat.primeFactors hprod
    _ = t := Nat.primeFactors_prod ht

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.primeFactors_largeOddKernel
statement:
theorem primeFactors_largeOddKernel (B n : ℕ) :
    (largeOddKernel B n).primeFactors = largeOddPrimeSupport B n
proof:
:= by
  rw [largeOddKernel]
  exact Nat.primeFactors_prod fun p hp ↦
    (prime_and_large_of_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport hp).1

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.primeFactors_smallOddPart
statement:
theorem primeFactors_smallOddPart (B n : ℕ) :
    (smallOddPart B n).primeFactors = smallOddPrimeSupport B n
proof:
:= by
  rw [smallOddPart]
  exact Nat.primeFactors_prod fun p hp ↦
    (prime_and_small_of_mem_smallOddPrimeSupport hp).1

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.squarefree_prod_primes
statement:
private theorem squarefree_prod_primes
    (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ p ∈ s, p.Prime) :
    Squarefree (s.prod id)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      simp
  | @insert p s hp ih =>
      have hpPrime : p.Prime := hs p (Finset.mem_insert_self p s)
      have hsPrime : ∀ q ∈ s, q.Prime := by
        intro q hq
        exact hs q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq)
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hp]
      apply (Nat.squarefree_mul ?_).mpr
      · exact ⟨hpPrime.squarefree, ih hsPrime⟩
      · apply Nat.Coprime.prod_right
        intro q hq
        apply (Nat.coprime_primes hpPrime (hsPrime q hq)).mpr
        intro hpq
        apply hp
        rwa [hpq]

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.largeOddKernel_squarefree
statement:
theorem largeOddKernel_squarefree (B n : ℕ) :
    Squarefree (largeOddKernel B n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [largeOddKernel]
  exact squarefree_prod_primes _ fun p hp ↦
    (prime_and_large_of_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport hp).1

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.smallOddPart_squarefree
statement:
theorem smallOddPart_squarefree (B n : ℕ) :
    Squarefree (smallOddPart B n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smallOddPart]
  exact squarefree_prod_primes _ fun p hp ↦
    (prime_and_small_of_mem_smallOddPrimeSupport hp).1

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.largeOddKernel_dvd
statement:
theorem largeOddKernel_dvd (B n : ℕ) :
    largeOddKernel B n ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [largeOddKernel]
  apply Finset.prod_primes_dvd n
  · intro p hp
    exact (prime_and_large_of_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport hp).1.prime
  · intro p hp
    exact Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors
      (largeOddPrimeSupport_subset_primeFactors B n hp)

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.smallOddPart_dvd
statement:
theorem smallOddPart_dvd (B n : ℕ) :
    smallOddPart B n ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [smallOddPart]
  apply Finset.prod_primes_dvd n
  · intro p hp
    exact (prime_and_small_of_mem_smallOddPrimeSupport hp).1.prime
  · intro p hp
    exact Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors
      (smallOddPrimeSupport_subset_primeFactors B n hp)

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.one_le_largeOddKernel
statement:
theorem one_le_largeOddKernel (B n : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ largeOddKernel B n
proof:
:=
  Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (largeOddKernel_ne_zero B n)

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.largeOddKernel_le
statement:
theorem largeOddKernel_le {B n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    largeOddKernel B n ≤ n
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_of_dvd hn (largeOddKernel_dvd B n)

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.largeOddKernel_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem largeOddKernel_mem_Icc {B n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    largeOddKernel B n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨one_le_largeOddKernel B n, largeOddKernel_le hn⟩

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.cardDistinctFactors_largeOddKernel
statement:
theorem cardDistinctFactors_largeOddKernel (B n : ℕ) :
    ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors (largeOddKernel B n) =
      (largeOddPrimeSupport B n).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors_apply, ← List.card_toFinset]
  change (largeOddKernel B n).primeFactors.card =
    (largeOddPrimeSupport B n).card
  rw [primeFactors_largeOddKernel]

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.disjoint_smallOddPrimeSupport_largeOddPrimeSupport
statement:
theorem disjoint_smallOddPrimeSupport_largeOddPrimeSupport (B n : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (smallOddPrimeSupport B n) (largeOddPrimeSupport B n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro p hpSmall hpLarge
  exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge
    (prime_and_small_of_mem_smallOddPrimeSupport hpSmall).2)
    (prime_and_large_of_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport hpLarge).2

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.smallOddPrimeSupport_union_largeOddPrimeSupport
statement:
theorem smallOddPrimeSupport_union_largeOddPrimeSupport (B n : ℕ) :
    smallOddPrimeSupport B n ∪ largeOddPrimeSupport B n =
      oddPrimeSupport n
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, mem_smallOddPrimeSupport,
    mem_largeOddPrimeSupport]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hp, _⟩ | ⟨hp, _⟩) <;> exact hp
  · intro hp
    exact (le_or_gt p B).elim
      (fun hpB ↦ Or.inl ⟨hp, hpB⟩)
      (fun hpB ↦ Or.inr ⟨hp, hpB⟩)

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.smallOddPart_mul_largeOddKernel
statement:
theorem smallOddPart_mul_largeOddKernel (B n : ℕ) :
    smallOddPart B n * largeOddKernel B n =
      (oddPrimeSupport n).prod id
proof:
:= by
  rw [smallOddPart, largeOddKernel,
    ← Finset.prod_union
      (disjoint_smallOddPrimeSupport_largeOddPrimeSupport B n),
    smallOddPrimeSupport_union_largeOddPrimeSupport]

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.smallOddPart_coprime_largeOddKernel
statement:
theorem smallOddPart_coprime_largeOddKernel (B n : ℕ) :
    (smallOddPart B n).Coprime (largeOddKernel B n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smallOddPart, largeOddKernel]
  apply Nat.Coprime.prod_left
  intro p hpSmall
  apply Nat.Coprime.prod_right
  intro q hqLarge
  have hpData := prime_and_small_of_mem_smallOddPrimeSupport hpSmall
  have hqData := prime_and_large_of_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport hqLarge
  apply (Nat.coprime_primes hpData.1 hqData.1).mpr
  exact Nat.ne_of_lt (hpData.2.trans_lt hqData.2)

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.canonical_largeOddKernel_decomposition
statement:
theorem canonical_largeOddKernel_decomposition
    {B n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n = canonicalSquarePart n ^ 2 *
        smallOddPart B n * largeOddKernel B n
proof:
:= by
  calc
    n = (oddPrimeSupport n).prod id * canonicalSquarePart n ^ 2 :=
      canonical_odd_mul_sq_decomposition hn
    _ = (smallOddPart B n * largeOddKernel B n) *
        canonicalSquarePart n ^ 2 := by
      rw [smallOddPart_mul_largeOddKernel]
    _ = canonicalSquarePart n ^ 2 *
        smallOddPart B n * largeOddKernel B n := by
      ac_rfl

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.canonicalSquarePart_ne_zero
statement:
theorem canonicalSquarePart_ne_zero
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    canonicalSquarePart n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro ha
  apply hn
  rw [canonical_largeOddKernel_decomposition (B := 0) hn, ha]
  simp

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.prime_dvd_largeOddKernel_iff
statement:
theorem prime_dvd_largeOddKernel_iff
    {B n p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    p ∣ largeOddKernel B n ↔ p ∈ largeOddPrimeSupport B n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← primeFactors_largeOddKernel B n,
    Nat.mem_primeFactors_of_ne_zero (largeOddKernel_ne_zero B n)]
  simp [hp]

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.prime_dvd_largeOddKernel_iff_large_odd
statement:
theorem prime_dvd_largeOddKernel_iff_large_odd
    {B n p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    p ∣ largeOddKernel B n ↔
      B < p ∧ Odd (n.factorization p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prime_dvd_largeOddKernel_iff hp,
    mem_largeOddPrimeSupport_iff_prime_large_odd]
  simp [hp]

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.prime_dvd_smallOddPart_iff
statement:
theorem prime_dvd_smallOddPart_iff
    {B n p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    p ∣ smallOddPart B n ↔ p ∈ smallOddPrimeSupport B n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← primeFactors_smallOddPart B n,
    Nat.mem_primeFactors_of_ne_zero (smallOddPart_ne_zero B n)]
  simp [hp]

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.prime_dvd_smallOddPart_iff_small_odd
statement:
theorem prime_dvd_smallOddPart_iff_small_odd
    {B n p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    p ∣ smallOddPart B n ↔
      p ≤ B ∧ Odd (n.factorization p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prime_dvd_smallOddPart_iff hp,
    mem_smallOddPrimeSupport_iff_prime_small_odd]
  simp [hp]

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.factorization_largeOddKernel
statement:
theorem factorization_largeOddKernel (B n p : ℕ) :
    (largeOddKernel B n).factorization p =
      if p ∈ largeOddPrimeSupport B n then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p ∈ largeOddPrimeSupport B n
  · rw [if_pos hp]
    exact Nat.factorization_eq_one_of_squarefree
      (largeOddKernel_squarefree B n)
      (prime_and_large_of_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport hp).1
      ((prime_dvd_largeOddKernel_iff
        (prime_and_large_of_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport hp).1).mpr hp)
  · rw [if_neg hp]
    apply Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp
    rw [Nat.support_factorization, primeFactors_largeOddKernel]
    exact hp

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.factorization_smallOddPart
statement:
theorem factorization_smallOddPart (B n p : ℕ) :
    (smallOddPart B n).factorization p =
      if p ∈ smallOddPrimeSupport B n then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p ∈ smallOddPrimeSupport B n
  · rw [if_pos hp]
    exact Nat.factorization_eq_one_of_squarefree
      (smallOddPart_squarefree B n)
      (prime_and_small_of_mem_smallOddPrimeSupport hp).1
      ((prime_dvd_smallOddPart_iff
        (prime_and_small_of_mem_smallOddPrimeSupport hp).1).mpr hp)
  · rw [if_neg hp]
    apply Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp
    rw [Nat.support_factorization, primeFactors_smallOddPart]
    exact hp

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.largeOddKernel_eq_one_iff_support_eq_empty
statement:
theorem largeOddKernel_eq_one_iff_support_eq_empty (B n : ℕ) :
    largeOddKernel B n = 1 ↔ largeOddPrimeSupport B n = ∅
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hk
    have hs := primeFactors_largeOddKernel B n
    rw [hk] at hs
    simpa using hs.symm
  · intro hs
    simp [largeOddKernel, hs]

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.largeOddKernel_eq_one_iff_hDefective
statement:
theorem largeOddKernel_eq_one_iff_hDefective (B n : ℕ) :
    largeOddKernel B n = 1 ↔ HDefective B n
proof:
:= by
  rw [largeOddKernel_eq_one_iff_support_eq_empty]
  constructor
  · intro hs p hpPrime hpB
    by_contra hpParity
    have hpMem :=
      (parityVec_ne_zero_iff_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport hpPrime hpB).mp hpParity
    rw [hs] at hpMem
    exact Finset.notMem_empty p hpMem
  · intro h
    apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    intro p hpMem
    have hpData := prime_and_large_of_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport hpMem
    exact (mem_largeOddPrimeSupport_iff.mp hpMem).2
      (h p hpData.1 hpData.2)

name: PaperC.channel_max_le_length_of_two_cells
statement:
theorem channel_max_le_length_of_two_cells
    {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    (hm : 2 ≤ (channelCells L a b h).card) :
    Nat.max a b ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  have hmUnits :
      2 ≤ (rationalChannelUnits L a b h).card := by
    rw [card_rationalChannelUnits_eq_channelCells]
    exact hm
  exact max_channelCoefficients_le_length ha hb hab hmUnits

name: PaperC.residualPrimeCells_eq_empty_of_cutoff_le
statement:
theorem residualPrimeCells_eq_empty_of_cutoff_le
    {L a b p : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    (hm : 2 ≤ (channelCells L a b h).card)
    (hp : p.Prime)
    (hcutoff : 4 * Nat.max a b * (L + 1) ≤ p) :
    residualPrimeCells L a b p h = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro cell hcell
  have hpLt :
      p < 4 * Nat.max a b * (L + 1) :=
    prime_lt_four_mul_max_of_mem_residualPrimeCells
      ha hb hab hm hcell hp
  omega

name: PaperC.residualVertexPrimeCells_eq_empty_of_cutoff_le
statement:
theorem residualVertexPrimeCells_eq_empty_of_cutoff_le
    {L a b p : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    (hm : 2 ≤ (channelCells L a b h).card)
    (hp : p.Prime)
    (hcutoff : 4 * Nat.max a b * (L + 1) ≤ p) :
    residualVertexPrimeCells L a b p h = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro cell hcell
  have hpLt :
      p < 4 * Nat.max a b * (L + 1) :=
    prime_lt_four_mul_max_of_mem_residualVertexPrimeCells
      ha hb hab hm hcell hp
  omega

name: PaperC.card_cast_le_residual_bound_of_subset
statement:
theorem card_cast_le_residual_bound_of_subset
    {L a b p : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    {s : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)}
    (hs : s ⊆ residualPrimeCells L a b p h)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    (hp : 0 < p)
    (hm : 2 ≤ (channelCells L a b h).card) :
    (s.card : ℚ) ≤
      (1 +
          ((8 * Nat.max a b * (L + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) / (p : ℚ)) *
        (1 + (((L + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / (Nat.max a b : ℚ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : s.card ≤ (residualPrimeCells L a b p h).card :=
    card_mono hs
  have hcardQ :
      (s.card : ℚ) ≤
        ((residualPrimeCells L a b p h).card : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcard
  exact hcardQ.trans
    (residualPrimeCells_card_cast_le ha hb hab hp hm)

name: PaperC.PrimeCountBridge.count_eq_card_smallPrimesUpTo
statement:
theorem count_eq_card_smallPrimesUpTo (H : ℕ) :
    PrimesUpTo.count H =
      (DefectCounting.smallPrimesUpTo H).card
proof:
:= by
  change Fintype.card (PrimeUpTo H) =
    (DefectCounting.smallPrimesUpTo H).card
  rw [Fintype.card_congr (primeUpToEquivSmallPrimes H)]
  exact Fintype.card_coe _

name: PaperC.one_div_two_pow_le_abs_integer_sub_dyadic
statement:
theorem one_div_two_pow_le_abs_integer_sub_dyadic
    (a b : ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (hne : (a : ℚ) ≠ (b : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ d) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ d ≤
      |(a : ℚ) - (b : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ d|
proof:
:= by
  have hden : (0 : ℚ) < (2 : ℚ) ^ d := by positivity
  have hrearrange :
      (a : ℚ) - (b : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ d =
        ((a * (2 : ℤ) ^ d - b : ℤ) : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ d := by
    norm_num only [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_ofNat]
    field_simp
  have hnum : a * (2 : ℤ) ^ d - b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
    rw [hrearrange, hzero]
    norm_num
  have hone : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |a * (2 : ℤ) ^ d - b| :=
    Int.one_le_abs hnum
  have honeQ :
      (1 : ℚ) ≤ ((|a * (2 : ℤ) ^ d - b| : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hone
  rw [hrearrange, abs_div, abs_of_pos hden, ← Int.cast_abs]
  exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hden).2 honeQ

name: PaperC.one_div_two_pow_le_abs_dyadic_sub_integer
statement:
theorem one_div_two_pow_le_abs_dyadic_sub_integer
    (a b : ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (hne : (b : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ d ≠ (a : ℚ)) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ d ≤
      |(b : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ d - (a : ℚ)|
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_sub_comm]
  exact one_div_two_pow_le_abs_integer_sub_dyadic a b d hne.symm

name: PaperC.one_div_two_pow_le_abs_integer_sub_dyadicPolynomialEval
statement:
theorem one_div_two_pow_le_abs_integer_sub_dyadicPolynomialEval
    (a u : ℤ) (p : ℤ[X]) (d : ℕ)
    (hne :
      (a : ℚ) ≠ ((p.eval u : ℤ) : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ d) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ d ≤
      |(a : ℚ) - ((p.eval u : ℤ) : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ d|
proof:
:=
  one_div_two_pow_le_abs_integer_sub_dyadic a (p.eval u) d hne

name: PaperC.one_div_two_pow_le_abs_integer_sub_polynomialEval
statement:
theorem one_div_two_pow_le_abs_integer_sub_polynomialEval
    (a u : ℤ) (P : ℚ[X]) (p : ℤ[X]) (d : ℕ)
    (hscaled :
      P.eval (u : ℚ) = ((p.eval u : ℤ) : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ d)
    (hne : (a : ℚ) ≠ P.eval (u : ℚ)) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ d ≤ |(a : ℚ) - P.eval (u : ℚ)|
proof:
:= by
  rw [hscaled] at hne ⊢
  exact one_div_two_pow_le_abs_integer_sub_dyadicPolynomialEval
    a u p d hne

name: PaperC.DefectivePredicate.hDefective_iff_even_factorization
statement:
theorem hDefective_iff_even_factorization (H n : ℕ) :
    HDefective H n ↔
      ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → H < p → 2 ∣ n.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [HDefective, parityVec_apply,
    ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]

name: PaperC.DefectivePredicate.hDefective_iff_parity_support_le
statement:
theorem hDefective_iff_parity_support_le (H n : ℕ) :
    HDefective H n ↔
      ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → parityVec n p ≠ 0 → p ≤ H
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h p hp hparity
    by_contra hpH
    exact hparity (h p hp (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hpH))
  · intro h p hp hpH
    by_contra hparity
    exact (Nat.not_le_of_gt hpH) (h p hp hparity)

name: PaperC.DefectivePredicate.defectPart_ne_zero_of_HDefectRepresentation
statement:
theorem defectPart_ne_zero_of_HDefectRepresentation
    {H n : ℕ} (rep : HDefectRepresentation H n) :
    rep.defectPart ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [DefectRepresentation.defectPart, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
  intro p hp
  exact (mem_smallPrimesUpTo.mp (rep.support_subset hp)).1.ne_zero

name: PaperC.DefectivePredicate.hDefective_of_HDefectRepresentation
statement:
theorem hDefective_of_HDefectRepresentation
    {H n : ℕ} (rep : HDefectRepresentation H n) :
    HDefective H n
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp hpH
  by_cases ha : rep.squarePart = 0
  · have hn : n = 0 := by
      rw [rep.value_eq, ha]
      simp
    subst n
    simp [parityVec_apply]
  · by_contra hparity
    have hp_dvd : p ∣ rep.defectPart :=
      DefectParitySupport.dvd_defectPart_of_eq_mul_sq_of_parityVec_ne_zero
        (defectPart_ne_zero_of_HDefectRepresentation rep) ha
        rep.value_eq hparity
    rw [DefectRepresentation.defectPart] at hp_dvd
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ :=
      (hp.prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff id).mp hp_dvd
    have hq_small := mem_smallPrimesUpTo.mp (rep.support_subset hq)
    have hp_eq_q : p = q :=
      (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hq_small.1).mp hpq
    exact (Nat.not_le_of_gt hpH) (hp_eq_q ▸ hq_small.2)

name: PaperC.DefectivePredicate.even_factorization_of_HDefectRepresentation
statement:
theorem even_factorization_of_HDefectRepresentation
    {H n p : ℕ} (rep : HDefectRepresentation H n)
    (hp : p.Prime) (hpH : H < p) :
    2 ∣ n.factorization p
proof:
:=
  (hDefective_iff_even_factorization H n).mp
    (hDefective_of_HDefectRepresentation rep) p hp hpH

name: PaperC.DefectivePredicate.factorization_eq_odd_add_two_half
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_odd_add_two_half (n : ℕ) :
    n.factorization =
      oddFactorization n + 2 • halfFactorization n
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [oddFactorization, halfFactorization, Finsupp.add_apply,
    Finsupp.mapRange_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, nsmul_eq_mul]
  exact (Nat.mod_add_div (n.factorization p) 2).symm

name: PaperC.DefectivePredicate.oddFactorization_apply_eq_one_of_mem
statement:
theorem oddFactorization_apply_eq_one_of_mem
    {n p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ oddPrimeSupport n) :
    oddFactorization n p = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp_ne : oddFactorization n p ≠ 0 :=
    Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hp
  simp only [oddFactorization, Finsupp.mapRange_apply] at hp_ne ⊢
  exact Nat.mod_two_ne_zero.mp hp_ne

name: PaperC.DefectivePredicate.prod_oddPrimeSupport_eq_prod_oddFactorization
statement:
theorem prod_oddPrimeSupport_eq_prod_oddFactorization (n : ℕ) :
    (oddPrimeSupport n).prod id =
